title.en: World Desk
title.zh: 全球焦点

strap.en: A fast view of global affairs, conflict, diplomacy, and human need.
strap.zh: 快速掌握国际局势、冲突、外交与人类处境。

title.en: Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages
title.zh: 摩尔多瓦边境两人死亡，俄乌无人机战争仍在继续

summary.en: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes. Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. In Kyiv, a woman was...
summary.zh: 据报道，乌克兰有五人死亡，俄罗斯有四人死亡，双方都发动了新的无人机袭击。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，两名俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和摩尔多瓦之间的边境口岸，导致两人死亡。事发后，Starokozache口岸被关闭。在乌克兰首都基辅，一名妇女死亡，14人受伤，此前一架俄罗斯无人机击中了一栋九层居民楼。在俄罗斯，据当地官员称，在...

body.en:
Two people died when Russian drones hit a border crossing between Ukraine and Moldova, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

The Starokozache crossing was shut after the overnight attack. Images from the scene show several burnt-out cars amid the debris.

In the Ukrainian capital Kyiv, a woman was killed and 14 people, including two children, were injured after a Russian drone hit a nine-storey residential house, officials say.

In Russia, four people, including a child, were killed in the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk in a Ukrainian drone attack, officials there say, and a drone hit an industrial facility in the Arctic city of Novy Urengoy, nearly 3,000km (1,864 miles) from Ukraine.

Russia and Ukraine recently stepped up long-range strikes, despite renewed diplomatic efforts to end the war.

Zelensky renewed calls for international support in the wake of the attack at the Starokozache road crossing, saying "the aggression must be stopped here and now before it spreads any further".

The crossing, about 500km south of Kyiv, was shut after the attack killed two people and injured three others, Odesa regional head Oleh Kiper said.

A Moldovan driver was also injured, according to the country's foreign ministry.

Moldova has increasingly found itself caught up in the conflict, with Prime Minister Vasile Tofan confirming that 17 drones struck Moldovan territory in August alone - more than during the whole of last year.

"Those who ignore or downplay these threats - and refuse to name the aggressor - are denying reality," he wrote on social media.

Russia's defence ministry said its forces had shot down 596 Ukrainian drones overnight.

Novorossiysk – in the south of the country - was hit hardest in what governor Veniamin Kondratiev described as a "massive overnight enemy drone attack".

As well as the four deaths, 29 people were injured, and damage was reported to residential buildings, a church and a preschool.

In Novy Urengoy, a drone attack on an "industrial facility" was repelled, regional governor Dmitry Artyukhov said.

He added that the falling drone wreckage had triggered a fire but no-one had been injured.

The strikes come a day after Russian President Vladimir Putin spoke to US President Donald Trump by phone about efforts to end the war.

The Trump administration has been pressing for direct talks between Russia and Ukraine, with Kyiv saying they could take place this month. The Kremlin, however, has said it is too early to discuss a date or venue.

The call followed Saturday's talks between US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff and Putin in Moscow, before the pair travelled to Kyiv for meetings with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday.
body.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯无人机袭击了乌克兰和摩尔多瓦之间的过境点，造成两人死亡。 夜间袭击后，斯塔科扎切过境点被关闭。现场图像显示，废墟中有几辆被烧毁的汽车。 官员称，在乌克兰首都基辅，一架俄罗斯无人机击中一栋九层住宅，导致一名妇女死亡，包括两名儿童在内的 14 人受伤。 俄罗斯官员称，在俄罗斯黑海港口新罗西斯克，乌克兰无人机袭击造成包括一名儿童在内的四人死亡，一架无人机袭击了距离乌克兰近 3,000 公里（1,864 英里）的北极城市新乌连戈伊的一处工业设施。 尽管俄罗斯和乌克兰为结束战争重新做出了外交努力，但最近还是加强了远程打击。 斯塔罗科扎切公路交叉口袭击事件发生后，泽连斯基再次呼吁国际社会提供支持，他表示“必须立即制止侵略行为，以免其进一步蔓延”。 敖德萨地区负责人奥莱·基佩尔表示，位于基辅以南约 500 公里处的过境点在袭击造成两人死亡、三人受伤后被关闭。 据摩尔多瓦外交部称，一名摩尔多瓦司机也受伤。 摩尔多瓦越来越多地陷入冲突，总理瓦西里·托凡证实，仅 8 月份就有 17 架无人机袭击了摩尔多瓦领土，比去年全年的数量还要多。 他在社交媒体上写道：“那些忽视或淡化这些威胁并拒绝说出侵略者姓名的人正在否认现实。” 俄罗斯国防部表示，俄罗斯军队一夜之间击落了 596 架乌克兰无人机。 位于该国南部的新罗西斯克在州长韦尼亚明·康德拉季耶夫 (Veniamin Kondratiev) 所说的“夜间大规模敌方无人机袭击”中受到的打击最为严重。 除 4 人死亡外，还有 29 人受伤，据报道住宅楼、一座教堂和一所幼儿园遭到损坏。 新乌连戈伊地区州长德米特里·阿秋霍夫 (Dmitry Artyukhov) 表示，无人机对“工业设施”的袭击被击退。 他补充说，坠落的无人机残骸引发了火灾，但没有人受伤。 袭击发生前一天，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普通电话，讨论了结束战争的努力。 特朗普政府一直敦促俄罗斯和乌克兰进行直接会谈，基辅表示可能于本月举行。然而，克里姆林宫表示，现在讨论日期或地点还为时过早。 周六，美国特使贾里德·库什纳、史蒂夫·威特科夫和普京在莫斯科举行了会谈，随后两人于周日前往基辅与乌克兰总统泽伦斯基会面。

reflection.en: The news from the Ukrainian-Moldovan border is a stark reminder of how conflict draws in more lives and lands. The cycle of retaliation, where each strike begets another, brings only further devastation. The call to overcome evil with good, rather than mirroring violence, remains a profound challenge in such times.
reflection.zh: 来自乌克兰-摩尔多瓦边境的新闻，令人痛心地提醒我们冲突如何牵连更多生命和土地。以暴制暴的报复循环只会带来进一步的毁灭。在这样的时代，‘以善胜恶’而非以恶报恶的呼吁，仍然是一个深刻的挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Trump to adress midterm convention after Qatar-gifted plane delayed by emergency-slide check – live
title.zh: 特朗普在共和党全国代表大会上成为焦点，为中期选举冒险

summary.en: President Trump is set to deliver speeches on both days of an unprecedented gathering, which Republicans are framing as a 'midterm convention' to counteract his unpopularity. Meanwhile, Stefany Shaheen, daughter of a New Hampshire senator, has won the Democratic nomination for a House seat, facing accusations of...
summary.zh: 总统特朗普将在前所未有的集会的两天内都发表讲话，共和党人将其定位为“中期选举大会”，以对抗他的不受欢迎度。与此同时，新罕布什尔州参议员的女儿斯蒂芬妮·沙欣赢得了众议院席位的民主党提名，但面临初选对手关于裙带关系的指控。

body.en: President to give speeches on both days of unconventional gathering in Dallas; president boards Air Force One after crew inspects the slide Republicans look to ‘midterm convention’ to overcome Trump unpopularity Sign up for US Breaking News email Stefany Shaheen, the daughter of a longtime New Hampshire senator and former governor, has won the Democratic nomination in the race for Chris Pappas’s former House seat. Stefany Shaheen’s mother Jeanne Shaheen is a former governor who has represented New Hampshire in the Senate since 2009. The younger Shaheen’s family ties to the Democratic establishment – and accusations of nepotism – became a point of attack by her opponent in the primary race. Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统将在这两天史无前例的聚会上发表演讲，共和党人希望通过“中期大会”来克服特朗普不受欢迎的情况。新罕布什尔州长期参议员和前州长的女儿史蒂芬妮·沙欣(Stefany Shaheen)在克里斯·帕帕斯(Chris Pappas)前众议院席位的竞选中赢得了民主党提名。斯蒂芬妮·沙欣 (Stefany Shaheen) 的母亲珍妮·沙欣 (Jeanne Shaheen) 是前州长，自 2009 年以来一直代表新罕布什尔州参议院。小沙欣的家庭与民主党建制派的关系 — — 以及裙带关系的指控 — — 成为她的对手在初选中攻击的一个焦点。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The political landscape often brings scrutiny to family ties and perceived advantages, as seen with Stefany Shaheen's nomination. The call to 'act justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God' reminds us to evaluate actions and motivations with integrity, seeking fairness and ethical conduct above all else, even amidst political maneuvering.
reflection.zh: 政治格局常常使家族关系和所谓的优势受到审视，正如斯蒂芬妮·沙欣的提名所示。‘行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与你的雅伟同行’的呼召提醒我们，即使在政治操纵之中，也要以正直来评估行为和动机，将公平和道德行为置于一切之上。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Apple unveils folding iPhone Duo as new CEO takes center stage
title.zh: 苹果推出折叠屏iPhone Duo，新CEO首次亮相

summary.en: Apple has launched the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone, marking a significant change since the iPhone's debut in 2007. The nearly $2,000 device, inspired by iPads, combines portability with large-screen functionality and serves as the first major challenge for new CEO John Ternus.
summary.zh: 苹果公司推出了其首款折叠屏智能手机iPhone Duo，这是自2007年iPhone问世以来最重大的变革。这款近2000美元的设备借鉴了苹果iPad的设计，并结合了iPhone的便携性和功能性。它也是新任首席执行官约翰·特努斯上任后的首次重大考验。

body.en: The passport-size iPhone Duo serves as the first big test for John Ternus, who took over for Tim Cook last week Apple has unveiled the iPhone Duo, the company’s first foldable phone and the most significant change to the iPhone since the smartphone’s introduction in 2007. The nearly $2,000 device takes inspiration from Apple iPads and combines it with the portability and features of iPhones. When opened, it is the company’s largest phone display and Apple’s thinnest iPhone. Continue reading...
body.zh: 护照大小的 iPhone Duo 是上周接替蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 的约翰·特努斯 (John Ternus) 面临的第一个重大考验。苹果公司推出了 iPhone Duo，这是该公司首款可折叠手机，也是自 2007 年推出智能手机以来对 iPhone 最重大的改变。这款近 2,000 美元的设备从苹果 iPad 中汲取灵感，并将其与 iPhone 的便携性和功能相结合。打开后，它是该公司最大的手机显示屏，也是苹果最薄的 iPhone。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The launch of the new iPhone Duo, a significant technological and business undertaking, presents a moment of both anticipation and challenge for Apple's leadership. As new ventures are initiated, whether in technology or any other field, the ancient wisdom of committing one's plans to a higher power offers a path to navigate uncertainty and strive for...
reflection.zh: 新款iPhone Duo的发布，这项重大的技术和商业举措，对苹果公司的领导层来说既是充满期待的时刻，也是一个挑战。无论是在科技领域还是其他任何领域，当新的事业启动时，将计划托付于更高力量的古老智慧，为应对不确定性和追求卓越指明了方向。这一原则鼓励在充分准备的同时，也要认识到最终的成功有赖于神的恩典和指引。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Uganda to withdraw from Invictus Games ‘out of respect for King Charles’, says military chief
title.zh: 乌干达军方首脑：为尊重查尔斯国王，将退出不可征服运动会

summary.en: Uganda's military chief, Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, announced the country's withdrawal from Prince Harry's Invictus Games. He cited 'tensions' and 'Harry-Meghan nonsense' as reasons, stating the decision was made 'out of respect for King Charles.'
summary.zh: 乌干达军方首脑穆胡兹·凯鲁加巴少将宣布，该国将退出哈里王子主办的不可征服运动会。他表示此举是“出于对查尔斯国王的尊重”，并引用“紧张局势”和“哈里-梅根的胡闹”作为退出原因。

body.en: Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba announces decision to pull out in post on X, citing tensions over ‘Harry-Meghan nonsense’ Uganda is withdrawing from the Duke of Sussex’s Invictus Games, the country’s military chief has said, out of respect for King Charles amid division over the “Harry-Meghan nonsense”. Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, son of the Ugandan president, made the surprise announcement in a post on X on Wednesday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴 (Muhoozi Kainerugaba) 将军宣布决定退出 X 频道，理由是“哈里-梅根胡言乱语”引发的紧张局势 乌干达军事参谋长表示，出于对查尔斯国王的尊重，在“哈里-梅根胡言乱语”存在分歧的情况下，出于对查尔斯国王的尊重，乌干达将退出苏塞克斯公爵的“不败运动会”。乌干达总统之子穆胡齐·凯内鲁加巴 (Muhoozi Kainerugaba) 将军于周三在 X 网站上发布了这一令人惊讶的消息。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision by Uganda's military chief to withdraw from the Invictus Games, citing 'tensions' and 'nonsense,' highlights how disagreements can lead to disengagement. Even when faced with perceived provocations, the pursuit of peace and understanding remains a vital principle, urging us to seek pathways for dialogue rather than withdrawal.
reflection.zh: 乌干达军方首脑以“紧张局势”和“胡闹”为由宣布退出不可征服运动会的决定，凸显了分歧如何导致脱离接触。即使面对所谓的挑衅，追求和平与理解仍然是一项重要的原则，促使我们寻求对话的途径，而不是选择退出。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Indonesian foragers may have sucked on mind-altering nuts 25,000 years ago, research finds
title.zh: 研究发现：25,000年前的印度尼西亚觅食者可能曾吸食改变心智的坚果

summary.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance, suggesting ancient Indonesian foragers may have routinely sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago, providing potentially the earliest evidence of human drug use.
summary.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析显示出牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，表明早在25,000年前，印度尼西亚的古代觅食者可能就习惯性地吸食改变心智的坚果，这可能是人类用药的最早证据。

body.en: Analysis of two skeletons reveals tooth wear and traces of psychoactive substance in what may be earliest known evidence for human drug taking What may be the earliest known evidence for human drug taking has been traced to ancient Indonesian foragers who sucked on mind-altering nuts as long as 25,000 years ago. Analysis of two exceptionally rare skeletons from the Indonesian island of Sulawesi revealed dramatic tooth wear and traces of a psychoactive substance in the individuals’ remaining teeth, suggesting they routinely sucked on hard, abrasive betel nuts. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对两具骨骼的分析揭示了牙齿磨损和精神活性物质的痕迹，这可能是人类吸毒的最早已知证据。 已知最早的人类吸毒证据可以追溯到古代印度尼西亚采集者，他们早在 25,000 年前就吸食了改变精神的坚果。对印度尼西亚苏拉威西岛的两具极其罕见的骨骼进行的分析显示，这些人的牙齿磨损严重，并且在剩余的牙齿中发现了精神活性物质的痕迹，这表明他们经常吮吸坚硬、磨蚀性的槟榔。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The discovery in Sulawesi offers a glimpse into the deep past, revealing how ancient peoples interacted with their environment. It reminds us that even in the earliest stages of human history, people sought altered states of consciousness, often through natural substances. The natural world has always been a source of both sustenance and mystery, offering...
reflection.zh: 在苏拉威西的发现让我们得以一窥遥远的过去，揭示了古代人类如何与他们的环境互动。它提醒我们，即使在人类历史的最早阶段，人们也通过天然物质寻求改变意识状态。自然界一直是食物和神秘的来源，提供了对人类行为和体验探索的见解。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Senior UK rabbis come out in support of sanctions on Israeli settlements
title.zh: 英国高级拉比支持对以色列定居点实施制裁

summary.en: Senior rabbis in the UK have voiced support for sanctions on Israeli settlements, emphasizing the need to address settler violence and highlighting a diversity of views within the Jewish community. This intervention follows the UK's chief rabbi's criticism of the sanctions.
summary.zh: 英国的资深拉比公开支持对以色列定居点实施制裁，强调必须解决定居者暴力问题，并指出犹太社群内部存在观点多样性。此前，英国首席拉比曾批评这些制裁措施。

body.en: Spiritual leaders stress diversity of views within Jewish community and warn against inaction on settler violence ‘It’s a good start’: prominent Israelis welcome UK sanctions Prominent British rabbis have backed Ed Miliband’s sanctions on Israeli settlements, warning that the time for inaction on settler violence must come to an end. The intervention comes after the UK’s chief rabbi, the spiritual leader of mainstream Orthodox Jews in the UK, Sir Ephraim Mirvis, described UK sanctions against illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territories as a “dark day for British Jews” and warned they could embolden people who “use hatred as a weapon against Jews”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 精神领袖强调犹太社区内部观点的多样性，并警告不要对定居者暴力不采取行动“这是一个好的开始”：以色列知名人士欢迎英国制裁英国著名拉比支持埃德·米利班德对以色列定居点的制裁，警告对定居者暴力不采取行动的时代必须结束。英国首席拉比、英国主流东正教犹太人的精神领袖埃弗雷姆·米尔维斯爵士(Sir Ephraim Mirvis)表示，英国对巴勒斯坦被占领土上的非法以色列定居点的制裁是“英国犹太人的黑暗一天”，并警告说，这可能会让那些“利用仇恨作为针对犹太人的武器”的人变得更加大胆。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the midst of complex geopolitical issues, these spiritual leaders are calling for justice and an end to violence. Their intervention reminds us that leadership, whether religious or political, carries a profound responsibility to act righteously and protect the vulnerable. May wisdom guide their path toward peace and accountability.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的地缘政治背景下，这些宗教领袖呼吁伸张正义并制止暴力。他们的介入提醒我们，无论是宗教还是政治领导层，都肩负着采取公正行动、保护弱势群体的重大责任。愿智慧指引他们走向和平与问责的道路。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Germany's connection to the September 11, 2001 attacks
title.zh: 德国与“9·11”袭击事件的联系

summary.en: The 9/11 attacks were partly planned in Hamburg by the so-called Hamburg cell, whose members played key roles in the plot. This event prompted a significant shift in Germany's approach to national security.
summary.zh: “9·11”袭击事件的部分计划是在汉堡通过所谓的“汉堡小组”进行的，其成员在阴谋中扮演了关键角色。这一事件促使德国在国家安全方面采取了重大转变。

body.en:
The 9/11 attacks were partly planned in Hamburg, via the so-called Hamburg cell, whose members played key roles in the plot. A look back at a day that shook up Germany’s approach to national security.

"This day has changed the world," German President Johannes Rau said. He had watched in shock as the burning Twin Towers of the World Trade Center collapsed in New York.

Nearly 3,000 people were killed on September 11, 2001, when Islamist terrorists hijacked four passenger planes and turned them into deadly weapons.

Germany’s head of state struggled to find the right words: "We do not know what political or social consequences what happened today will have — what we have watched unfold on our television screens in shock, barely able to comprehend or even reflect on it."

It soon emerged that the victims include people from 92 countries, among them 11 Germans.

The following day, a rapidly spreading rumor was confirmed: Three of the four suspected hijackers had recently lived in Hamburg. The Islamist terrorists were thought to have been led by Egyptian-born Mohammed Atta, who had come to the northern German city in the early 1990s to study.

At some point, the young man became radicalized, particularly at Hamburg's Al-Quds Mosque, which was later closed by German security authorities. He spent the final three years of his life in an apartment shared with two other suspected attackers in the Harburg district.

The so-called Hamburg terrorist cell was believed to have included six men, among them Moroccan national Mounir al-Motassadeq. He was charged as an accomplice in the world's first trial related to the September 11, 2001, attacks . In 2003, the Hanseatic Higher Regional Court sentenced him to the maximum 15-year prison term for aiding and abetting thousands of murders and for membership in a terrorist organization.

After serving his sentence, al-Motassadeq was deported to his native Morocco. Another suspected attacker from the circle around pilot Mohammed Atta was Ramzi Binalshibh, who was born in Yemen and had been held without trial at the US detention facility at Guantanamo Bay since 2006.

The United States detained hundreds of suspects at the prison, which human rights groups and international bodies have described as contrary to international law. Among them was Murat Kurnaz , who was born in Bremen. He was released in August 2006 after nearly five years without evidence establishing his involvement in the terrorist attacks.

Kurnaz later recounted his experience in a book that was adapted into a film in 2013 .

Meanwhile, investigative committees in the German Bundestag sought to determine why Kurnaz and other suspects had wrongly come under the scrutiny of American and German intelligence...
body.zh: 9/11 袭击的部分计划是在汉堡通过所谓的汉堡小组策划的，该小组的成员在该阴谋中发挥了关键作用。回顾改变德国国家安全方针的一天。 “这一天改变了世界，”德国总统约翰内斯·劳说道。他震惊地看着纽约世贸中心双子塔燃烧着倒塌。 2001 年 9 月 11 日，伊斯兰恐怖分子劫持了四架客机并将其变成致命武器，造成近 3,000 人死亡。 德国国家元首努力寻找合适的措辞：“我们不知道今天发生的事情会产生什么政治或社会后果——我们震惊地看到电视屏幕上发生的事情，几乎无法理解，甚至无法反思。” 很快就有消息称，遇难者包括来自 92 个国家的人，其中包括 11 名德国人。 第二天，一个迅速传播的谣言得到证实：四名劫机嫌疑人中的三人最近住在汉堡。伊斯兰恐怖分子被认为是由埃及出生的穆罕默德·阿塔领导的，他于 20 世纪 90 年代初来到这座德国北部城市学习。 在某个时候，这位年轻人变得激进，特别是在汉堡的圣城清真寺，该清真寺后来被德国安全当局关闭。他在哈尔堡区与另外两名袭击嫌疑人合住的公寓里度过了生命的最后三年。 据信，所谓的汉堡恐怖分子组织包括六名男子，其中包括摩洛哥国民穆尼尔·莫塔萨德克(Mounir al-Motassadeq)。在世界上首例与 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击有关的审判中，他被指控为共犯。 2003年，汉萨地区高等法院以协助和教唆数千起谋杀案以及恐怖组织成员身份判处他最高15年的监禁。 刑满释放后，穆塔萨德被驱逐回祖国摩洛哥。飞行员穆罕默德·阿塔周围的另一名疑似袭击者是拉姆齐·比纳尔什布 (Ramzi Binalshibh)，他出生于也门，自 2006 年以来未经审判就被关押在美国关塔那摩湾拘留所。 美国在该监狱拘留了数百名嫌疑人，人权组织和国际机构称此举违反了国际法。其中包括出生于不莱梅的穆拉特·库尔纳兹 (Murat Kurnaz)。近五年来，没有证据证明他参与了恐怖袭击，他于 2006 年 8 月被释放。 库尔纳兹后来在一本书中讲述了他的经历，该书于2013年被改编成电影。 与此同时，德国联邦议院的调查委员会试图确定为什么库尔纳兹和其他嫌疑人错误地接受了美国和德国情报部门的审查……

reflection.en: The 9/11 attacks, with roots in Hamburg, serve as a stark reminder of how acts of terror can reshape a nation's security posture and global outlook. The challenge remains to respond to such evil not with mirroring violence, but with a commitment to justice and peace, embodying the principle of overcoming evil with good.
reflection.zh: “9·11”袭击事件，其根源可追溯至汉堡，是恐怖行为如何重塑国家安全态势和全球视野的严峻警示。挑战依然在于，我们如何不以同等的暴力回应邪恶，而是以对公正与和平的承诺来克服邪恶，践行以善胜恶的原则。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title.zh: 谷歌选择芬兰作为其在欧洲的最大单笔投资

summary.en: The US tech giant announces a €13 billion investment in Finland to build AI infrastructure, including three new data centers and an existing site expansion, which is expected to create tens of thousands of jobs and is powered partly by nuclear energy.
summary.zh: 这家美国科技巨头宣布将在芬兰投资130亿欧元建设人工智能基础设施，包括三个新的数据中心和一个现有站点的扩建，预计将创造数万个就业机会，部分由核能供电。

body.en:
Google will buy up to half the electricity produced by one of Finland's nuclear power plants as part of a record €13bn (£11bn; $15bn) investment in the country's AI infrastructure, the company announced.

The US tech giant said the package would fund three new data centres, expand an existing site and support energy projects to power growing demand for AI services.

"This is Google's largest single investment in Europe and a testament to Finland's leadership in responsibly building AI infrastructure," the company said on Wednesday.

"Google's decision is a clear testament to our strengths," Finland's Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said in a statement.

As part of the deal, Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to 50% of the output from the Loviisa nuclear power plant.

Earlier this week, TikTok announced a $1bn investment in Finland to build a new data centre in Kouvola, pointing to the country's "strong digital infrastructure, clean energy mix, robust data governance and skilled tech talent".

Finland has emerged as an attractive location for data centres because of its cool climate, plentiful low-carbon electricity and relatively uncongested power grid. The colder temperatures can reduce the energy needed to cool facilities packed with computer servers.

Technology companies are racing to secure power supplies as the AI boom drives demand for vast networks of data centres.

The Google investment is expected to support more than 37,000 jobs during construction and boost Finland's GDP by €3.6bn a year, according to Google. Construction is set to take place in 2027 and 2028.

"The value of the data economy extends far beyond direct investment into spurring innovation, research and development," Orpo added.

"Deepening our collaboration with Google will deliver lasting benefits for both parties."

Google will build new data centres in Kajaani, Muhos and Vaala, while expanding its existing facility in Hamina, which it established after converting a former paper mill in 2009.

The infrastructure will help support products such as its AI chatbot Gemini, alongside services including Search, Maps and YouTube.

Google said the investments also covered "clean energy projects, and dedicated nature and community funds to support local biodiversity, education, research, and workforce development".

"Google is proud to deepen our roots in Finland," said Ruth Porat, president and chief investment officer of Alphabet and Google.

"This investment underscores Google's commitment to grow our presence responsibly, pairing the expansion of our technical infrastructure with new energy capacity, grid enhancements, and energy affordability initiatives," she added.

Earlier this year, Google's parent company Alphabet raised its global...
body.zh: 该公司宣布，谷歌将购买芬兰一座核电站最多一半的电力，作为该国人工智能基础设施创纪录的 130 亿欧元（110 亿英镑；150 亿美元）投资的一部分。 这家美国科技巨头表示，该计划将为三个新数据中心提供资金，扩建现有站点并支持能源项目，以满足日益增长的人工智能服务需求。 该公司周三表示：“这是谷歌在欧洲最大的单笔投资，证明了芬兰在负责任地建设人工智能基础设施方面的领导地位。” 芬兰总理佩特里·奥尔波在一份声明中表示：“谷歌的决定清楚地证明了我们的优势。” 作为交易的一部分，谷歌与芬兰公用事业公司 Fortum 签署了一份为期 22 年的合同，购买洛维萨核电站最多 50% 的电力。 本周早些时候，TikTok 宣布在芬兰投资 10 亿美元，在科沃拉建设一个新的数据中心，并指出该国“强大的数字基础设施、清洁能源组合、强大的数据治理和熟练的技术人才”。 芬兰因其凉爽的气候、充足的低碳电力和相对不拥堵的电网而成为数据中心的有吸引力的地点。较低的温度可以减少冷却装有计算机服务器的设施所需的能源。 随着人工智能的蓬勃发展推动了对庞大数据中心网络的需求，科技公司正在竞相确保电力供应。 据谷歌称，谷歌的投资预计将在建设期间支持超过 37,000 个就业岗位，并使芬兰的 GDP 每年增加 36 亿欧元。施工预计于 2027 年和 2028 年进行。 奥尔波补充道：“数据经济的价值远远超出了直接投资的范围，还可以刺激创新、研究和开发。” “深化我们与谷歌的合作将为双方带来持久的利益。” 谷歌将在卡亚尼、穆霍斯和瓦阿拉建立新的数据中心，同时扩大其在哈米纳的现有设施，该设施是谷歌于 2009 年改造前造纸厂后建立的。 该基础设施将帮助支持 AI 聊天机器人 Gemini 等产品，以及搜索、地图和 YouTube 等服务。 谷歌表示，这些投资还涵盖“清洁能源项目，以及支持当地生物多样性、教育、研究和劳动力发展的专用自然和社区基金”。 Alphabet 和谷歌总裁兼首席投资官露丝·波拉特 (Ruth Porat) 表示：“谷歌很自豪能够加深我们在芬兰的根基。” 她补充道：“这项投资凸显了谷歌致力于负责任地扩大我们的影响力，将我们的技术基础设施的扩张与新能源产能、电网增强和能源负担能力计划结合起来。” 今年早些时候，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 筹集了全球...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of human knowledge, particularly in fields like Artificial Intelligence, is a hallmark of our times. As we build ever more complex systems, like Google's new AI infrastructure in Finland, we are reminded of Daniel's prophecy that 'knowledge shall increase.' This growth brings immense potential but also calls for wisdom and ethical...
reflection.zh: 人类知识的飞速发展，尤其是在人工智能等领域，是我们这个时代的标志。当我们构建日益复杂的系统时，例如谷歌在芬兰的新人工智能基础设施，我们不禁想起但以理的预言——“知识必然增长”。这种增长带来了巨大的潜力，但也要求我们在应用中具备智慧和道德考量。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Serbia, the conflicted EU candidate
title.zh: 塞尔维亚，这个陷入冲突的欧盟候选国

summary.en: Serbia has officially pursued EU membership for years, but its accession process has stalled significantly. The recent state-supported funeral for convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic in Belgrade has highlighted the deep disconnect between Serbia's actions and European values, raising questions about its commitment to...
summary.zh: 塞尔维亚多年来正式寻求加入欧盟，但其入盟进程已严重停滞。最近在贝尔格莱德为被判刑的战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇举行的国家支持的葬礼，凸显了塞尔维亚的行为与欧洲价值观之间的深刻脱节，并对其加入欧盟的承诺及其政治方向提出了质疑。

body.en:
On paper, Belgrade has pursued EU membership for years. But accession has long been stalled. The hero's farewell given to war criminal Mladic exposed just how far Serbia has alienated itself from Europe.

The  state-supported funeral of Ratko Mladic in Belgrade this week has raised a pressing question in Brussels: Can a country seek EU membership while giving a hero's farewell to a convicted war criminal? For many , the event has shown that Serbia's accession process has not merely stalled. It has largely lost its political drive.

"For too long, the EU has kept treating Serbia  as a normal candidate country," Engjellushe Morina of the European Council on Foreign Relations told DW, despite Belgrade's continued backsliding on democracy and the rule of law.

Naim Leo Besiri of Serbia's Institute for European Affairs adds: "The ruling majority in Serbia has not performed anything that was promised on the reform agenda during the last five years."

Both experts point out that Belgrade has refused to join EU sanctions against Russia . Democratic standards have deteriorated under nationalist President Aleksandar Vucic , while relations with Kosovo remain tense.

Despite having been sentenced to life imprisonment by a UN court for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes,  Ratko Mladic was buried in Belgrade on Monday with military honors and the participation of government representatives. President Vucic stayed away, but facilitated and defended the public mourning.

Brussels reacted unusually strongly. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen called the images shocking. European Council President Antonio Costa condemned the glorification of war criminals. Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos canceled a visit to Serbia.

But both Morina and Besiri say that this is not enough. They believe Vucic has been given too much room to maneuver for too long. In their perception,  he has been treated as an indispensable partner who could secure stability in the Western Balkans and keep Serbia anchored to the West, despite disregarding basic European values.

Besiri says Serbian civil society had warned Brussels for years about attacks on media freedom, the rule of law and democratic institutions. But, he adds, the EU largely turned a blind eye.

Economic relations demonstrate the strong ties between the EU and Serbia. The bloc is Serbia's largest trading partner, investor and financial donor. Politically, however, Serbia has developed a close partnership with Moscow.

A common argument for continuing relations with Serbia is therefore based on the concern that greater pressure could push the country further towards Russia or China.

Morina accepts that isolating Serbia would be dangerous, but sees other options between...
body.zh: 从表面上看，贝尔格莱德多年来一直在寻求加入欧盟。但加入进程却长期停滞不前。这位英雄与战犯姆拉迪奇的告别暴露了塞尔维亚与欧洲的疏远程度。 本周在贝尔格莱德举行的由国家支持的拉特科·姆拉迪奇葬礼在布鲁塞尔引发了一个紧迫的问题：一个国家能否在寻求加入欧盟的同时，向一名被定罪的战犯进行英雄般的告别？对于许多人来说，这一事件表明塞尔维亚的入盟进程不仅停滞不前。它在很大程度上已经失去了政治动力。 欧洲外交关系委员会的莫里纳（Engjellushe Morina）对德国之声表示：“长期以来，欧盟一直将塞尔维亚视为正常的候选国。”尽管贝尔格莱德在民主和法治方面持续倒退。 塞尔维亚欧洲事务研究所的纳伊姆·利奥·贝西里 (Naim Leo Besiri) 补充道：“塞尔维亚的执政多数派在过去五年中没有履行改革议程上的任何承诺。” 两位专家都指出，贝尔格莱德拒绝加入欧盟对俄罗斯的制裁。在民族主义总统亚历山大·武契奇的领导下，民主标准有所恶化，而与科索沃的关系仍然紧张。 尽管拉特科·姆拉迪奇因种族灭绝罪、反人类罪和战争罪被联合国法院判处无期徒刑，但他仍于周一在贝尔格莱德以军事荣誉和政府代表的参与下葬。武契奇总统没有出席，但为公众哀悼提供了便利和辩护。 布鲁塞尔的反应异常强烈。欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩称这些图像令人震惊。欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔谴责美化战犯的行为。扩大事务专员玛尔塔·科斯取消了对塞尔维亚的访问。 但莫里纳和贝西里都表示这还不够。他们认为武契奇长期以来被给予了太多的回旋余地。在他们看来，他被视为不可或缺的合作伙伴，可以确保西巴尔干地区的稳定，并使塞尔维亚锚定在西方，尽管他无视欧洲的基本价值观。 贝西里表示，塞尔维亚民间社会多年来一直就针对媒体自由、法治和民主机构的攻击向布鲁塞尔发出警告。但他补充道，欧盟基本上对此视而不见。 经济关系体现了欧盟与塞尔维亚之间的牢固联系。该集团是塞尔维亚最大的贸易伙伴、投资者和财政捐助者。然而，在政治上，塞尔维亚与莫斯科建立了密切的伙伴关系。 因此，继续与塞尔维亚保持关系的一个常见理由是担心更大的压力可能会促使该国进一步向俄罗斯或中国靠拢。 莫里纳承认孤立塞尔维亚是危险的，但他认为还有其他选择……

reflection.en: The news from Serbia presents a stark image of a nation at a crossroads, its aspirations for European integration complicated by the honoring of a convicted war criminal. This situation raises profound questions about leadership and national identity. When a nation's leaders and public sentiment elevate those who have committed atrocities, it signals a deep...
reflection.zh: 塞尔维亚的新闻描绘了一个处于十字路口国家的鲜明图景，其对欧洲一体化的渴望因对被判刑的战犯的尊崇而变得复杂。这种情况引发了关于领导力和国家认同的深刻问题。当一个国家的领导人和公众舆论推崇犯下暴行的人时，这标志着在追求正义与和平方面存在着深刻的裂痕，阻碍了其迈向更统一、更公正未来的步伐。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Oil hits $100 a barrel for first time since July after US and Houthi strikes
title.zh: 油价飙升至每桶100美元，此前美军与胡塞武装发生冲突

summary.en: Oil prices surpassed $100 a barrel for the first time since July, driven by escalating tensions and attacks in the Gulf region. The US struck five Iranian tankers in retaliation for Iran's targeting of a warship, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed to have attacked eight tankers and two warships, as well as a US...
summary.zh: 由于海湾地区紧张局势和袭击事件加剧，油价自7月以来首次突破每桶100美元。美国击毁了五艘伊朗油轮，以报复伊朗袭击一艘军舰；伊朗革命卫队则声称袭击了八艘油轮和两艘军舰，以及约旦的一处美军基地。也门胡塞武装在袭击沙特阿拉伯的石油设施后，也报告了沙特方面的空袭。

body.en:
Oil prices rose to $100 (£74) a barrel on Wednesday, after the US and Iran attacked tankers in the Gulf region and Yemen's Houthis hit oil facilities in Saudi Arabia.

Overnight, the US said it struck five Iranian tankers in retaliation for Iran's targeting of a warship, while Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they attacked eight tankers and two warships in response, as well as a US base in Jordan.

The Guards also said they planned a new "prohibited zone" for shipping that extended beyond the Strait of Hormuz into the Arabian Sea.

The Iran-backed Houthis reported dozens of Saudi strikes in Yemen, a day after drone and missile attacks caused fires at several oil facilities in Saudi Arabia.

The escalating conflicts pushed the price of Brent crude, the global benchmark, to its highest level since late July, when Iran and the US resumed hostilities after a one-month lull.

A barrel was priced at $100.70, up 2.83% compared to Tuesday, on Wednesday afternoon.

Before the US and Israel's war with Iran began in February, Brent crude had been priced at about $70 (£52) a barrel.

But Iranian missile and drone attacks on commercial shipping and a US naval blockade of Iranian ports resulted in the effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz waterway in the Gulf, through which 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) shipments usually pass.

The Houthis have also been targeting Saudi energy infrastructure and tankers in the Red Sea since July, when a four-year ceasefire in Yemen began unravelling.

The rising oil costs have sparked leaps in petrol prices around the world for motorists .

The US military's Central Command (Centcom) said early on Wednesday that its latest strikes destroyed four Iranian oil tankers linked to Iran's Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) in the Gulf of Oman - Kaviz, Charminar, Horizon 1 and Riesco - and a fifth tanker - Derya - near Kharg Island, in the northern Gulf, which hosts Iran's main terminal for exporting oil.

US forces directed the crews to abandon ship before the vessels were struck, it added.

Centcom said the attacks came after the IRGC launched ballistic missiles at a US warship in the region twice in two days. It added that the warship "successfully evaded" the missiles and that no American troops were harmed.

The IRGC said its Aerospace Force launched missiles at US maintenance facilities, hangars and aircraft at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan overnight in retaliation for the US strikes.

Jordan's armed forces said they intercepted 20 Iranian missiles and two others fell in unpopulated areas, with no casualties were reported.

Later, the IRGC said its navy also attacked two US Navy destroyers and eight oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, causing "heavy damage" to the vessels.

The UK Maritime Trade...
body.zh: 在美国和伊朗袭击海湾地区的油轮以及也门胡塞武装袭击沙特阿拉伯的石油设施后，周三油价上涨至每桶 100 美元（74 英镑）。 一夜之间，美国表示，它袭击了五艘伊朗油轮，以报复伊朗袭击一艘军舰，而伊朗革命卫队表示，他们袭击了八艘油轮和两艘军舰，以及美国在约旦的基地。 卫兵还表示，他们计划设立一个新的航运“禁区”，从霍尔木兹海峡延伸到阿拉伯海。 伊朗支持的胡塞武装报告称，沙特在也门发动了数十次袭击，一天前无人机和导弹袭击导致沙特阿拉伯多个石油设施起火。 不断升级的冲突将全球基准布伦特原油价格推升至7月下旬以来的最高水平，当时伊朗和美国在一个月的平静后恢复了敌对行动。 周三下午，每桶价格为100.70美元，较周二上涨2.83%。 在 2 月份美国和以色列与伊朗的战争开始之前，布伦特原油的价格约为每桶 70 美元（52 英镑）。 但伊朗对商业航运的导弹和无人机袭击以及美国海军对伊朗港口的封锁导致海湾霍尔木兹海峡水道的有效关闭，世界上 20% 的石油和液化天然气 (LNG) 运输通常要经过该海峡。 自7月也门为期四年的停火开始瓦解以来，胡塞武装还一直瞄准红海的沙特能源基础设施和油轮。 石油成本的上涨引发了世界各地驾车者的汽油价格飞涨。 美国军方中央司令部(Centcom)周三早些时候表示，其最新的袭击摧毁了阿曼湾与伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队(IRGC)有联系的四艘伊朗油轮——Kaviz、Charminar、Horizo​​n 1和Riesco——以及第五艘油轮——Derya——靠近海湾北部的哈格岛，该岛是伊朗主要石油出口码头的所在地。 声明补充说，美军在船只被击中之前指示船员弃船。 中央司令部表示，袭击发生之前，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队在两天内两次向该地区的一艘美国军舰发射弹道导弹。声明补充说，这艘军舰“成功躲避”了导弹，没有美军受伤。 伊朗革命卫队表示，其航空航天部队连夜向约旦穆瓦法克萨尔蒂空军基地的美国维修设施、机库和飞机发射了导弹，以报复美国的袭击。 约旦武装部队表示，他们拦截了 20 枚伊朗导弹，另外两枚导弹落在无人居住地区，没有人员伤亡的报告。 随后，伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队表示，其海军还在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了两艘美国海军驱逐舰和八艘油轮，对船只造成“严重损坏”。 英国海事贸易...

reflection.en: The news reports a dangerous escalation of attacks and counter-attacks between the US and Iran, with oil prices reacting sharply. This cycle of retaliation, where each action provokes a response, traps nations in a destructive pattern. The ancient wisdom reminds us to break this cycle: 'Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.' May leaders...
reflection.zh: 新闻报道了美国与伊朗之间危险的袭击与反袭击升级，油价也因此大幅波动。这种每一次行动都引发回应的报复循环，将国家困在破坏性的模式中。古老的智慧提醒我们打破这个循环：“不要被恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。”愿领导者们能找到勇气，选择缓和局势与和平的道路，而非加剧冲突。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Watch: Norway bids farewell to King Harald
title.zh: 挪威国王哈拉尔向全国告别

summary.en: Tens of thousands of people lined the streets to pay their respects after 13 days of national mourning for King Harald V of Norway, whose funeral marked the end of his reign and the beginning of his son's.
summary.zh: 在为挪威国王哈拉尔五世举行的为期13天的全国哀悼期结束后，数万人沿街向他致敬，他的葬礼标志着他统治的结束和他儿子统治的开始。

body.en:
Tributes have been paid to King Harald V after his funeral in Norway's capital Oslo, with the Prince of Wales and other European royals among attendees.

Flags were raised from half-mast to mark the conclusion of a private ceremony at Akershus Fortress, where the king was laid to rest in the crypt of the Palace Chapel after a public service at Oslo Cathedral.

Tens of thousands of people lined the streets to pay their respects after 13 days of national mourning.

The new king Haakon VIII - Harald's son - and his family stood on the balcony of the Royal Palace and waved to thousands of people gathered outside.
body.zh: 哈拉尔五世国王的葬礼在挪威首都奥斯陆举行，人们向他表示哀悼，威尔士亲王和其他欧洲王室成员也出席了葬礼。 下半旗致哀，标志着在阿克斯胡斯城堡举行的私人仪式的结束，国王在奥斯陆大教堂举行公共仪式后被安葬在宫殿教堂的地下室。 经过13天的全国哀悼后，数万人走上街头表达哀悼。 新国王哈康八世——哈拉尔德的儿子——和他的家人站在皇宫的阳台上，向聚集在外面的数千人挥手致意。

reflection.en: Norway bids farewell to King Harald V after a long reign, marking the end of an era. The nation mourns, but also looks to the future with the new King Haakon VIII. This transition reminds us that, as Ecclesiastes says, there is a time for everything – a time for leadership and a time for rest, a time for mourning and a time for new beginnings.
reflection.zh: 挪威向其国王哈拉尔五世告别，他度过了漫长的统治时期，标志着一个时代的结束。国家在哀悼，但也随着新国王哈康八世展望未来。这次过渡提醒我们，正如传道书所说，万事皆有时——有在位之时，也有安息之时；有哀恸之时，也有新开始之时。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Mother demands answers, weeks after black woman found hanging from Mississippi tree
title.zh: 女子被发现吊在密西西比树上数周后，母亲要求答案

summary.en: The mother of Tasia Fortune, a black woman found hanging from a tree in Jackson, Mississippi, has told the BBC she is still waiting for answers from officials more than a month later. Her demands have been echoed by a community in the southern US state that has been left shocked and angry. Police confirmed they are...
summary.zh: 在密西西比州杰克逊市，一名黑人女子塔西娅·财富（Tasia...

body.en:
The mother of a black woman whose body was found hanging from a tree in Jackson, Mississippi, has told the BBC she is still waiting for answers from officials more than a month later.

Her demands have been echoed by a community in the southern US state that has been left shocked and angry.

After weeks of silence, police on Tuesday confirmed for the first time that they were investigating the death of Tasia Fortune, 29, as a potential homicide - while clarifying that her official cause of death has yet to be confirmed.

Authorities discovered Fortune's body on 3 August, hanging from a tree in the lot of an abandoned home.

Local concern over her death has been heightened by the fact that the state has a dark history of racial violence and lynchings.

The majority-black city has been left on edge. As the question lingers as to how Fortune died, petitions online signed by tens of thousands of people have called for more transparency, and members of US Congress have asked for federal intervention.

"It's making me angry," Fortune's mother, Christy Spivey, said. "What is the hold up?"

Spivey described desperate attempts to understand the status of the investigation and how multiple enquiries to police had gone unanswered.

The first update she had received from authorities in weeks came in a public city meeting on Tuesday evening as Jackson Police Chief RaShall Brackney discussed the case and said the department "has been investigating this case from day one as a homicide".

Brackney, in a statement to the BBC, elaborated and said the department always treats any pending death case as a "potential homicide" so that crucial evidence is not lost as police wait on autopsy results.

The department, though, had only previously described the case as a death investigation.

Tuesday's statement from Brackney said "we are conducting the investigation at the highest appropriate level while we await the medical examiner's findings", which would include an official cause and manner of death.

Spivey last saw her daughter alive on 26 July, when Fortune had travelled from Mississippi, where she had lived for roughly the last decade, to Kentucky, where Spivey lives, for a family reunion.

The next time she saw her daughter - in a funeral home, days before her burial - she could barely look at her body.

"I didn't look straight at her. Her daddy did," she said. "I kind of looked from the side."

Spivey remembered their last conversation. "She was talking about, you know, maybe even coming home," she explained.

Fortune's death has left the community concerned that racial violence in Mississippi could be on the rise again. And in the absence of concrete details about the case, their suspicions are left to fester.

Fortune's death was the third incident in Mississippi...
body.zh: 密西西比州杰克逊市一名黑人妇女的尸体被发现吊在树上，她的母亲告诉英国广播公司，一个多月后，她仍在等待官员的答复。 她的要求得到了美国南部州一个社区的响应，该社区感到震惊和愤怒。 经过数周的沉默后，警方周二首次证实，他们正在调查 29 岁的塔西亚·福琼 (Tasia Fortune) 的死亡，将其视为潜在的凶杀案，同时澄清，她的官方死因尚未得到证实。 当局于 8 月 3 日在一处废弃房屋的空地上发现了吊在树上的福琼的尸体。 该州有着种族暴力和私刑的黑暗历史，这加剧了当地对她死亡的担忧。 这座黑人占多数的城市陷入了紧张的境地。随着《财富》是如何消亡的问题依然存在，数万人在网上签署的请愿书呼吁提高透明度，美国国会议员也要求联邦干预。 “这让我很生气，”福琼的母亲克里斯蒂·斯皮维说。 “有什么事耽搁了？” 斯皮维描述了他拼命试图了解调查进展的情况，以及向警方多次询问却没有得到答复的情况。 周二晚上，杰克逊市警察局局长拉肖尔·布拉克尼(RaShall Brackney)在一次公开城市会议上讨论了此案，并表示该部门“从第一天起就将这起案件作为凶杀案进行调查”。 布拉克尼在给英国广播公司的一份声明中详细阐述并表示，该部门始终将任何悬而未决的死亡案件视为“潜在的凶杀案”，以便在警方等待尸检结果时不会丢失重要证据。 不过，该部门此前仅将此案描述为死亡调查。 布拉克尼周二的声明表示，“我们正在以最高适当级别进行调查，同时等待法医的调查结果”，其中包括官方的死因和方式。 斯皮维最后一次见到她活着的女儿是在 7 月 26 日，当时《财富》从她居住了大约十年的密西西比州前往斯皮维居住的肯塔基州参加家庭团聚。 当她下次见到女儿时——在葬礼前几天，在殡仪馆——她几乎无法看她的尸体。 “我没有直视她。她爸爸看了，”她说。 “我是从侧面看的。” 斯皮维还记得他们最后一次谈话。 “她在谈论，你知道，甚至可能回家，”她解释道。 福琼的去世让社会担心密西西比州的种族暴力可能再次上升。由于缺乏有关此案的具体细节，他们的怀疑只会愈演愈烈。 福琼之死是密西西比州发生的第三起事件……

reflection.en: The mother of Tasia Fortune is seeking answers and justice for her daughter, a voice crying out in the face of silence and uncertainty. Her persistent demands highlight the profound need to advocate for those who have been silenced, ensuring their stories are heard and their dignity is upheld. This echoes the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 塔西娅·财富的母亲在面对沉默和不确定时，为女儿寻求答案和正义，她的声音在呐喊。她持续的诉求凸显了为那些被剥夺话语权的人发声的深刻需要，确保他们的故事被听到，他们的尊严得到维护。这呼应了为那些无法为自己辩护的人挺身而出的号召，要求问责和真相。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Iran tightens social control with crackdown on cafes
title.zh: 伊朗因担心助长反政府情绪而加强对咖啡馆的社会管控

summary.en: Iranian authorities have recently intensified their scrutiny of cafes in Tehran, viewing them as potential hubs for fostering anti-government sentiment and facilitating protests. On July 19 alone, at least seven cafes and restaurants were reportedly shut down for non-compliance with mandatory hijab regulations,...
summary.zh: 伊朗当局近期加强了对首都德黑兰咖啡馆的审查，认为它们可能助长反政府情绪并促进抗议活动。据人权组织HRANA称，仅在7月19日，就有至少七家咖啡馆和餐馆因未能遵守强制性头巾规定而被勒令关闭。

body.en:
Authorities are keeping a close eye on cafes, fearing they could play a role in fostering anti-government sentiment.

Iranian authorities have launched a clampdown on cafes in the capital, Tehran, in recent months, suspecting them of fostering anti-government sentiment and facilitating protests.  

According to the human rights organization HRANA, at least seven cafes and restaurants were shut down on July 19 alone for allegedly failing to comply with mandatory hijab rules.

Previously, some media outlets, including Javan , a newspaper affiliated with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) , have described cafes as "gathering places for protesters" who, in their view, pose a threat to "national security."

Most recently, the "Vanak Park" cafes in Tehran were sealed, resulting in at least 200 people losing their jobs.

Authorities believe cafes, because of their widespread presence and popularity, could play a role in organizing mass protests.

The government's fears are rooted in the latest wave of protests in Iran, which began on December 28, 2025, and grew into the country's largest uprising since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.

Saediniya, a well-known cafe chain with 10 branches in Iran, closed its branches on this day in support of calls for strikes. It was subsequently accused of engaging in "propaganda against the state."

Iran's Supreme Court has now upheld the sentence of Sadegh Saedinia, the owner of the cafe chain, to 12 years and six months in prison, along with the confiscation of his assets.

He was arrested over his support for the protests, and all branches of his cafe chain were confiscated and shut down by judicial order.

Other cafes, including "Lamiz" and "Voria," faced a broadly similar fate. Voria is owned by a prominent Iranian footballer. Both were sealed by judicial order because of their indirect support for calls to protest. Cafe closures have not been confined to periods of protest, however, and the practice continues.

Tehran has seen a surge in the number of cafes over the past decade, rising from around 300 in the early 2010s to as many as 4,000 now, according to various estimates. 

Some experts attribute the growing number to changes in urban lifestyles in recent years. They see this as more than the expansion of a particular type of business and describe it as a sign of wider social and cultural changes within Iranian society.

"The explosive growth of cafes in society can, to some extent, be seen as a social response to living in a state of chronic crisis," Saba Alaleh, a clinical psychologist and psychoanalyst whose work focuses on political and social issues, told DW's Persian service.

"In such circumstances, people are not simply looking to consume or be entertained. They are looking for a...
body.zh: 当局正在密切关注咖啡馆，担心它们可能会助长反政府情绪。 近几个月来，伊朗当局对首都德黑兰的咖啡馆进行了取缔，怀疑它们煽动反政府情绪并为抗议活动提供便利。 据人权组织 HRANA 称，仅 7 月 19 日，就有至少 7 家咖啡馆和餐馆因涉嫌未遵守强制性头巾规定而被关闭。 此前，包括伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）下属报纸《爪哇报》在内的一些媒体将咖啡馆描述为“抗议者的聚集地”，他们认为抗议者对“国家安全”构成威胁。 最近，德黑兰“瓦纳克公园”咖啡馆被查封，导致至少200人失业。 当局认为，咖啡馆因其广泛存在和受欢迎而可以在组织大规模抗议活动中发挥作用。 政府的担忧源于伊朗最近一波抗议活动，该抗议活动始于2025年12月28日，并发展成为该国自1979年伊斯兰革命以来最大规模的起义。 在伊朗拥有10家分店的知名连锁咖啡馆Saediniya在这一天关闭了分店，以支持罢工的呼声。随后它被指控从事“反国家宣传”。 伊朗最高法院现已维持这家咖啡馆连锁店老板 Sadegh Saedinia 的刑期，判处 12 年零 6 个月监禁，并没收其资产。 他因支持抗议活动而被捕，他的咖啡馆连锁店的所有分店都被司法命令没收和关闭。 其他咖啡馆，包括“Lamiz”和“Voria”，也面临着大致相似的命运。 Voria 的所有者是一位著名的伊朗足球运动员。两人均因间接支持抗议呼吁而被司法命令封存。然而，咖啡馆关闭并不局限于抗议时期，而且这种做法仍在继续。 根据各种估计，过去十年德黑兰的咖啡馆数量激增，从 2010 年代初期的约 300 家增加到现在的 4,000 家之多。 一些专家将这一数字的增加归因于近年来城市生活方式的变化。他们认为这不仅仅是特定类型企业的扩张，并将其描述为伊朗社会内部更广泛的社会和文化变革的标志。 专注于政治和社会问题的临床心理学家和精神分析师萨巴·阿拉勒 (Saba Alaleh) 告诉德国之声波斯语频道：“社会上咖啡馆的爆炸式增长在某种程度上可以被视为对长期危机状态的社会反应。” “在这种情况下，人们不仅仅是为了消费或娱乐。他们正在寻找......

reflection.en: In Tehran, cafes are being targeted by authorities, with at least seven shut down for failing to enforce hijab rules. This action highlights a tension between state control and personal expression, raising questions about justice and freedom. The prophet Amos declared, 'Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!' May we...
reflection.zh: 在德黑兰，咖啡馆正成为当局的目标，至少有七家因未能执行头巾规定而被关闭。这一行动凸显了国家控制与个人表达之间的紧张关系，并引发了对公正和自由的疑问。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”愿我们祈祷，公正与自由能为所有人民带来繁荣。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Ethiopia's constitutional reform: What does it mean — especially for Abiy?
title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚宪法改革：这对阿比意味着什么？

summary.en: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed could benefit from planned constitutional reforms that would reshape the country's political power, potentially granting him a stronger mandate.
summary.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德可能从计划中的宪法改革中受益，这些改革将重塑该国的政治权力格局，并可能赋予他更强大的执政授权。

body.en:
Does Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed stand to benefit from a planned constitutional reform in the country? A new presidential system would reshape political power — and could give him even more power in office.

Since 2018, Abiy Ahmed has been the most powerful man in Ethiopian politics, governing the country during some of its most trying days in recent history. From the Tigray war to a feeble but lasting peace with neighboring Eritrea , Abiy has actively shaped and reshaped Ethiopia's role in Africa and indeed the world.

Soon, he might even get to consolidate more power and influence in his office, as Ethiopia 's political system might fundamentally change in the future.

Following weeks-long consultations, there are indications that the offices of prime minister and president could potentially be merged. This would mean that the largely ceremonial presidency could thus become the center of political power in the country.

While details about the precise re-designing of the system remain unclear, local reports say that the consultations indeed resulted in a positive recommendation to create a stronger presidency.

During a drawn-out national dialogue with around 4,000 delegates in Addis Ababa in recent weeks, participants discussed some of the country's key political conflict, including: the overall structure of the state, ongoing ethnic tensions, the rule of law and human rights — as well as the role of the prime minister.

Abiy did not take part in these meetings but could benefit significantly from their endorsement of a presidential system.

One key element for any constitutional reform to be pushed through parliament is already in place: Abiy won June's parliamentary elections   with a massive majority, which could help him and his party with advocating for a presidency with broader executive powers.  

Supporters of a stronger presidency see it as a way of bringing Ethiopia's ethnically and regionally fragmented society closer together.

A president representing the country as a whole could help strengthen a national political identity.

Befeqadu Hailu, an Ethiopian civil rights activist and political commentator, told DW that this might be a strength of the proposed new system, and that a president directly elected by the public would have a stronger mandate to govern.

Hailu believes that in future elections, a presidential candidate would have to convince "more than one ethnic group and more than one religious group" to win an election, which could help strengthen democratic processes.

At the same time, he issued a warning that "[p]residential systems are more prone descending into dictatorship."

body.zh: 埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德是否会从该国计划中的宪法改革中受益？新的总统制将重塑政治权力，并可能赋予他更多的执政权力。 自 2018 年以来，阿比·艾哈迈德一直是埃塞俄比亚政坛最有权势的人，在近代历史上最艰难的一些日子里统治着这个国家。从提格雷战争到与邻国厄立特里亚的微弱但持久的和平，阿比积极塑造和重塑了埃塞俄比亚在非洲乃至世界的角色。 很快，他甚至可能会在自己的办公室中巩固更多的权力和影响力，因为埃塞俄比亚的政治制度未来可能会发生根本性的变化。 经过长达数周的磋商，有迹象表明总理和总统的办公室可能会合并。这意味着，主要是仪式性的总统职位可能因此成为该国政治权力的中心。 虽然有关系统重新设计的具体细节仍不清楚，但当地报道称，磋商确实产生了建立更强有力的总统职位的积极建议。 最近几周，在亚的斯亚贝巴与约 4,000 名代表举行了一场旷日持久的全国对话，与会者讨论了该国的一些关键政治冲突，包括：国家的整体结构、持续的种族紧张局势、法治和人权，以及总理的角色。 阿比没有参加这些会议，但可以从他们对总统制的认可中受益匪浅。 议会推动的任何宪法改革的一个关键要素已经到位：阿比以绝对多数赢得了 6 月的议会选举，这可能有助于他和他的政党倡导拥有更广泛行政权力的总统职位。 支持更强有力的总统职位的支持者认为，这是使埃塞俄比亚种族和地区分裂的社会更加团结的一种方式。 代表整个国家的总统可以帮助加强国家政治认同。 埃塞俄比亚民权活动人士、政治评论员贝菲卡杜·海鲁(Befeqadu Hailu)告诉德国之声，这可能是拟议新制度的优势，由公众直接选举产生的总统将拥有更强的执政权力。 海鲁认为，在未来的选举中，总统候选人必须说服“多个民族和多个宗教团体”才能赢得选举，这可能有助于加强民主进程。 与此同时，他发出警告称“住宅系统更容易陷入独裁。” 但关键...

reflection.en: As Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed considers constitutional reforms that could reshape political power, the question of righteous rule arises. Proverbs 16:12 reminds leaders that integrity and justice are the foundation of a stable throne, urging a focus on ethical governance over the mere accumulation of power.
reflection.zh: 随着埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德考虑可能重塑政治权力的宪法改革，一个关于公义统治的问题浮现出来。《箴言》16:12 提醒领导者，正直和公义是稳固宝座的基础，敦促他们关注合乎道德的治理，而非仅仅是权力的积累。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Canada says it can 'pivot and prosper' without the US. But at what cost?
title.zh: 加拿大称其可以在没有美国的情况下“转型并繁荣”。但代价是什么？

summary.en: Canada and the US have "arguably the most interconnected trade" in the world — and tariffs will likely hit those in the middle. The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds". Canada matched the US...
summary.zh: 加拿大和美国拥有“可以说是世界上联系最紧密的贸易”，而关税可能会打击中间群体。美国和加拿大之间不断升级的贸易战可能导致整个北美地区大规模裁员，因为这两个长期盟友发现自己“严重分歧”。加拿大对价值200亿美元（277亿加元）的美国商品征收高达50%的关税，以回应美国上个月对加拿大商品征收的同等关税。双方的谈判已经破裂，没...

body.en:
The escalating trade war between the United States and Canada could cause mass layoffs across North America, as the long-term allies find themselves "at serious odds".

The latest round of retaliatory tariffs took effect overnight, as Canada matched the US by imposing levies of up to 50 per cent on US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) worth of US goods.

The Canadian levies follow 50 per cent tariffs the US imposed on some US$20 billion ($27.7 billion) of Canadian goods last month , after several rounds of negotiations collapsed, with no new talks scheduled.

The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, both of whom have blamed the other for the failed talks, as the 18-month-old trade war intensifies.

But the costs could go beyond economics, as the countries have historically relied on close trade and supply-chain ties.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

As former US ambassador to Canada David Cohen explained, many products, such as motor vehicles, cross the two countries' borders several times during the manufacturing process.

"The trade relationship between the United States and Canada is arguably the most interconnected trade relationship anywhere in the world," he told ABC Radio National on Wednesday morning.

The "people getting hurt" are not the leaders of Canada and the US, he added, but small and medium-sized businesses getting "caught in the middle".

On Monday, US President Donald Trump said on social media that Canadian private jet maker Bombardier would no longer be allowed to sell its planes in the US unless it started manufacturing in the country, without saying whether an official government order would follow.

While Bombardier is owned by Canada, the company employs more than 1,000 US workers in Kansas and works with US companies across 47 states.

Blocking this manufacturing is a "clear example" of the two countries' interconnectedness, Cohen said, as an attempt to punish Canada will also affect US workers.

"In a trade war, the only people being hurt are small businesses and individual employees in both Canada and the United States. That can't go on. We have to find a resolution to it," Cohen said.

Jessica Genauer, an expert in international conflict and international relations at the University of NSW, said recent animosity stems back to Trump's first term as president and has been reignited.

"What we're seeing now is a much more fractious, deep-seated antagonism that's starting to emerge," she told SBS News.

Comments made by Trump that undermine Canada's sovereignty and national identity, such as referring to the country as a 51st state of the US, have been "particularly egregious" to Canadians.

body.zh: 美国和加拿大之间不断升级的贸易战可能会导致北美地区大规模裁员，因为这两个长期盟友发现自己“陷入了严重的矛盾”。 最新一轮报复性关税一夜之间生效，加拿大效仿美国，对价值 200 亿美元（合 277 亿美元）的美国商品征收高达 50% 的关税。 在几轮谈判破裂且没有安排新的谈判之后，美国上个月对约200亿美元（277亿美元）的加拿大商品征收了50%的关税，之后加拿大又征收了50%的关税。 随着持续 18 个月的贸易战愈演愈烈，这次破裂扩大了这两个长期盟友之间的裂痕，双方都将谈判失败归咎于对方。 但成本可能超出经济范围，因为这些国家历来依赖密切的贸易和供应链联系。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 正如美国前驻加拿大大使大卫·科恩所解释的那样，许多产品，例如机动车辆，在制造过程中多次跨越两国边境。 “美国和加拿大之间的贸易关系可以说是世界上联系最紧密的贸易关系，”他周三上午告诉美国广播公司国家广播电台。 他补充说，“受伤的人”不是加拿大和美国的领导人，而是“夹在中间”的中小企业。 周一，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在社交媒体上表示，加拿大私人飞机制造商庞巴迪将不再被允许在美国销售其飞机，除非它开始在美国生产，但没有透露是否会发布正式的政府命令。 虽然庞巴迪公司归加拿大所有，但该公司在堪萨斯州雇佣了 1,000 多名美国工人，并与 47 个州的美国公司合作。 科恩表示，阻止这种制造业是两国相互联系的“明显例子”，因为惩罚加拿大的企图也会影响美国工人。 “在贸易战中，唯一受到伤害的是加拿大和美国的小企业和个人雇员。这种情况不能再继续下去。我们必须找到解决方案，”科恩说。 新南威尔士大学国际冲突和国际关系专家杰西卡·格纳尔表示，最近的敌意可以追溯到特朗普的第一个总统任期，并且已经重新点燃。 她告诉 SBS 新闻：“我们现在看到的是一种更加难以控制、根深蒂固的对抗正在开始出现。” 特朗普发表的损害加拿大主权和国家认同的言论，例如将该国称为美国第 51 个州，对加拿大人来说“尤其令人震惊”。 加拿大总理...

reflection.en: The escalating trade war between Canada and the US, marked by retaliatory tariffs and collapsed negotiations, illustrates the difficulty of maintaining peace between close allies. Even as nations assert their independence, the call to 'live at peace with everyone' remains a challenge, urging us to seek reconciliation over conflict.
reflection.zh: 加拿大和美国之间不断升级的贸易战，以报复性关税和谈判破裂为标志，说明了在亲密盟友之间维持和平的困难。即使国家宣称独立，‘与众人和睦’的呼召仍然是一个挑战，促使我们寻求和解而非冲突。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.

title.en: Fine art thieves nab two 'priceless' Renoir paintings from French museum
title.zh: 法国博物馆两幅“无价”雷诺阿画作被盗艺术品大盗落网

summary.en: Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday. Local authorities described the robbery as a "wake-up call" regarding the protection of fine art.
summary.zh: 周二，两名窃贼在法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆盗走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。当地官员称此次盗窃是对艺术品展示和保护方式的一次“警钟”。

body.en:
Two thieves stole two Renoir paintings from a museum on the French Riviera on Tuesday.

Local authorities said the pair broke in shortly before 6 am (2 pm AEST) by cutting a hole in a garden fence and entering through a window.

The stolen paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, whose most valuable works have fetched dozens of millions of dollars at auctions, were Madame Colonna Romano and Young Woman at the Well. Both belong to Paris' famous Orsay Museum and were on loan to the museum.

The thieves had taken two more paintings, Madame Pichon and Coco Reading, a portrayal of Claude, the young son of the famous Impressionist artist, but dropped them in the gardens as police, alerted by alarms, arrived and gave chase, local mayor Bryan Masson and the Marseille prosecutor's office said.

Masson said of the paintings, "They are priceless; you cannot sell them just like that."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The Marseille prosecutor added that an investigation had been opened into theft by an organised gang.

The museum, set up in 1960 in Renoir's mansion on a hill near Nice where he died in 1919, had 13 paintings by the master on display and some 40 sculptures, items of furniture and photographs.

Masson, a member of the far-right National Rally (RN) party, called for greater security for museums around France.

"This incident should serve as a wake-up call about the protection of our museums, which are now facing a new form of crime targeting works of art," he said.

The French government has come under pressure to tackle dramatic failures in the security of the country’s museums.

A French parliamentary report this summer said museums lacked resources and were ill-prepared to safeguard precious artworks and cultural artefacts.

A culture ministry survey in 2024 found that only one in four institutions had an emergency and risk-prevention plan, and nearly half lacked any video surveillance.

Art thieves in Europe are committing more violent robberies, and specialist gangs have been replaced by ad hoc opportunists recruited through social media, pan-European police body Europol said last month.

It cited a heist at the Louvre Museum in Paris in October last year as a prime example. Other French museums were also targeted in the past months.

"They are attacking all museums now, we must react," Luc, a neighbour of the Renoir museum, told BFM TV.

body.zh: 周二，两名小偷从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了两幅雷诺阿的画作。 地方当局称，两人在早上 6 点（澳大利亚东部时间下午 2 点）前不久，在花园栅栏上挖了一个洞，然后从窗户进入。 皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿最有价值的作品在拍卖会上以数千万美元成交，被盗的画作是《科隆纳·罗马诺夫人》和《井边的年轻女子》。这两件作品均属于巴黎著名的奥赛博物馆，并被该博物馆借出。 当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示，窃贼又拿走了两幅画作《皮尚夫人》(Madame Pichon)和《可可·雷丁》(Coco Reading)，画的是著名印象派艺术家的小儿子克洛德(Claude)，但当警察接到警报后赶到并追赶时，窃贼把它们扔到了花园里。当地市长布莱恩·马森(Bryan Masson)和马赛检察官办公室表示。 马森谈到这些画作时说：“它们是无价的；你不能就这样卖掉它们。” 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 马赛检察官补充说，已对一个有组织团伙的盗窃行为展开调查。 该博物馆建于 1960 年，位于雷诺阿位于尼斯附近一座小山上的宅邸，雷诺阿于 1919 年在尼斯去世，馆内展出了这位大师的 13 幅画作以及约 40 件雕塑、家具和照片。 马森是极右翼国家集会党 (RN) 的成员，他呼吁加强法国各地博物馆的安全。 他说：“这一事件应该为我们的博物馆的保护敲响警钟，我们的博物馆现在面临着一种针对艺术品的新形式的犯罪​​。” 法国政府面临着解决该国博物馆安全方面严重失误的压力。 今年夏天的一份法国议会报告称，博物馆缺乏资源，而且在保护珍贵艺术品和文化文物方面准备不足。 文化部2024年的一项调查发现，只有四分之一的机构制定了应急和风险防范计划，近一半的机构没有视频监控。 泛欧警察机构欧洲刑警组织上个月表示，欧洲的艺术品窃贼正在实施更加暴力的抢劫，专业团伙已被通过社交媒体招募的临时机会主义者所取代。 它以去年十月巴黎卢浮宫博物馆发生的抢劫案为例。过去几个月，其他法国博物馆也成为攻击目标。 雷诺阿博物馆的邻居吕克告诉 BFM 电视台：“他们现在正在袭击所有博物馆，我们必须做出反应。” 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: The audacious theft of two Renoir masterpieces, valued in the millions, speaks to the human heart's susceptibility to coveting what is not theirs. The pursuit of such 'treasures' often leads down paths of deceit and illegality, ultimately bringing no lasting good, as the proverb warns that dishonest scales are an abomination to Yahweh.
reflection.zh: 盗窃两幅价值连城的雷诺阿杰作，揭示了人心对不属于自己的东西的贪婪。对这些“珍宝”的追求常常导致欺骗和非法行为，最终不会带来任何持久的好处，正如箴言所警示的，不公的秤是雅伟所憎恶的。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Saudi oil sites hit as Houthi attacks intensify amid US-Iran fighting
title.zh: 沙特石油设施遭袭，胡塞武装袭击加剧，美伊冲突升级

summary.en: Yemen's Iranian-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, injuring over 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze. Simultaneously, explosions were reported at Iran's major oil hub and in the Gulf of Oman, suggesting a potential resumption of US strikes.
summary.zh: 也门受伊朗支持的胡塞武装周二袭击了沙特阿拉伯南部四个城市，造成70多人受伤，并点燃了石油设施。与此同时，据伊朗媒体报道，伊朗主要石油枢纽哈尔格岛以及阿曼湾的杰斯克港也发生爆炸，表明美国可能在美国与伊朗的冲突暂停两天后恢复了打击行动。

body.en:
Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels attacked four cities in southern Saudi Arabia, a US ally, on Tuesday, injuring more than 70 people and setting oil facilities ablaze in what appeared to be a significant escalation of the six-month-old conflict in the Middle East.

At the same time, explosions were reported on Kharg Island, Iran's major oil hub, and in the Gulf of Oman port of Jask, according to Iranian media, suggesting that US strikes against Iran may have resumed following a two-day pause.

Iranian news agency Tasnim reported that a US missile hit an Iranian tanker approximately 6 kilometres from Kharg Island. The vessel’s crew was reportedly being evacuated, although no casualties were reported, citing local sources.

The Pentagon did not immediately comment on the reports. However, a Fox News reporter, citing unidentified senior US officials, said the strikes were carried out by the US military.

In Saudi Arabia, the Houthis, who control most of Yemen's populated areas including the capital, said they had launched a broad operation deep into Saudi territory.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They used drones and missiles to strike a Saudi airbase in the southern city of Khamis Mushait as well as Saudi state oil company assets in the cities of Abha, Najran and Jazan.

NASA satellite images showed a thick cloud of black smoke over the Jazan refinery and a column of white smoke rising from an oil distribution centre in Abha.

Saudi authorities described blazes at the sites and said women and children were among the 73 people hurt.

The reports of such large numbers of wounded suggested the attacks were among the biggest carried out against Saudi Arabia since the US and Israel launched their war against Iran in February.

No confirmed images from the ground of the attacked Saudi cities were available, and witnesses could not be reached in a country where media is tightly controlled.

After a month of calm in August, fighting in the Gulf has resumed, with Iran and the US exchanging fire, sending global oil prices back towards the US$100 ($138.5) a barrel level passed at the war's peak.

Prices for benchmark Brent crude and US West Texas Intermediate rose and were on track for their highest closes since 23 July.

Houthi attacks on southwestern Saudi Arabia have the potential to worsen the war's global economic impact by disrupting Middle East energy supplies beyond the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.

Saudi Arabia has led an Arab coalition battling against the Houthis in Yemen for more than a decade. That war had calmed in recent years, but a ceasefire there has broken down, with the Houthis threatening shipping at the mouth of the Red Sea.

title.en: 'Absolute nightmare': Mass flight cancellations in the UK prompt calls for dismissals
title.zh: “简直是噩梦”：英国大规模航班取消引发解雇呼声

summary.en: Nearly 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled overnight due to a 'system issue'.
summary.zh: 由于“系统问题”，英国机场往返的近1100个航班在夜间被取消。

body.en:
Consumer chaos has descended on the UK's busiest airports as an air traffic glitch causes major disruptions, prompting calls to fire the head of the air traffic control service.

Almost 1,100 flights to and from UK airports were cancelled Tuesday, due to what the country's air traffic control service called a technical issue, in this latest error.

A total of 1,055 flights to and from British airports had been axed by 8pm (5am AEST) according to the aircraft tracking website FlightRadar24.

"Recovery from today's system issue has taken longer than we had hoped," Britain's air traffic control service, known as NATS, said on social media.

"Our system issue is now resolved, we are operating normally and working as hard as possible to clear the backlog of flights," it noted, adding "this is hugely frustrating and apologise unreservedly".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Tuesday's issues follow a technical glitch in July last year that saw scores of flights to and from the UK cancelled and which prompted anger from airline chiefs.

Britain saw its worst air systems failure in years in 2023, with more than 700,000 passengers affected after hundreds of flights were delayed or cancelled.

Heathrow Airport, Britain's largest and busiest airport, in west London, confirmed it was among those affected on Tuesday, along with Gatwick to the south of the UK capital.

"It's just an absolute nightmare down there," healthcare worker Josie Donoghue said of Gatwick after leaving the airport, having had to disembark her flight to Ireland after three hours stuck on the runway.

"Getting through that airport was like trying to get out of Alcatraz," she told Britain's domestic Press Association news agency.

Liverpool, Birmingham and Edinburgh airports were also affected, while Dublin Airport in Ireland said it had cancelled dozens of flights.

British Airways said it had to cancel or divert more than 100 flights, affecting tens of thousands of its customers.

Irish no-frills carrier Ryanair said more than 65,000 passengers had been disrupted and it had cancelled more than 50 flights.

Arsenal, due to play Napoli in the Champions League on Wednesday in the southern Italian city, were forced to cancel a press conference ahead of the match after the team's flight was delayed.

UK transport secretary Heidi Alexander said on X she was "seeking assurances that lessons will be learned and systems that support aviation are up to the job".

But Ryanair COO Neal McMahon repeated his calls for NATS chief executive Martin Rolfe to be fired, accusing him of having again "failed UK travellers".

body.en: Musician is also rattled to find her appearance gets far more attention than her playing in this reflective documentary from Lorna Tucker As well as her film about her own difficult teenage years , British director Lorna Tucker is probably best known for her documentaries on famous women with big personalities: Vivienne Westwood ( Westwood: Punk, Icon, Activist ), Katharine Hepburn (Call Me Kate) and Greta Garbo ( Garbo: Where Did You Go? ). Her latest subject, pianist Yuja Wang, is another high-achiever – but not someone with quite the same name recognition unless you’re a devotee of classical music, a field in which she is ranked among the very best alive. Wang certainly has a flamboyant side, expressed in her highly expressive, virtuoso performances and her sartorial style on stage. In fact some shocking pull quotes illustrate how her dress sense has been bizarrely over-examined in the press; she has been likened to a stripper for her outfits, and the New Yorker, of all publications, once described her as “fat” , which hardly seems germane to any discussion of her ability to play Tchaikovsky or Ligeti. But Wang’s biography and the texture of her daily life are very different from that of Tucker’s previous subjects. She was a child prodigy from an artistic Beijing family who came of age just in time to break records for views on YouTube. Sure, her life here looks glamorous in one way, with a lush New York apartment she barely ever sees because she’s constantly on the road. But her life is also one of perpetual practice and striving for perfection, the loneliness of the long-distance soloist. It’s a regimen that leaves almost no time for relationships or family, or even many friendships with peers who understand what she is going through – apart from a few mentors or collaborators such as fellow pianist Emanuel Ax or composer Teddy Abrams, with whom she recently won a Grammy. Still, she comes across as an effervescent character, intellectually curious and deeply attuned to the music she plays. Continue reading...
body.zh: 音乐家还惊讶地发现，在洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 的这部反思性纪录片中，她的外表比她的演奏受到更多关注。除了她关于自己艰难的青少年时期的电影外，英国导演洛娜·塔克 (Lorna Tucker) 最出名的可能是她关于具有大个性的著名女性的纪录片：维维安·韦斯特伍德 (维维安·韦斯特伍德) (韦斯特伍德：朋克、偶像、激进分子)、凯瑟琳·赫本 (叫我凯特) 和葛丽泰·嘉宝 (嘉宝：你去哪儿了？)。她最新的对象钢琴家王羽佳是另一位成就斐然的人，但除非你是古典音乐的爱好者，否则她的知名度不会很高，而她在古典音乐领域被列为当今最优秀的音乐爱好者之一。王确实有华丽的一面，这体现在她极具表现力、精湛的表演和舞台上的服装风格上。事实上，一些令人震惊的引述说明了媒体如何奇怪地过度审视了她的着装品味。她因服装而被比作脱衣舞娘，所有出版物中的《纽约客》曾将她描述为“胖子”，这似乎与她扮演柴可夫斯基或利盖蒂的能力的任何讨论都没有关系。但王的传记和她的日常生活质感与塔克之前的主题有很大不同。她是来自北京一个艺术家庭的神童，成年后正好打破了 YouTube 上的观看次数记录。当然，她在这里的生活在某种程度上看起来很迷人，她几乎从未见过纽约的一套豪华公寓，因为她经常在路上。但她的生活也是一种不断练习和追求完美的生活，一种长距离独奏者的孤独。这种生活方式几乎没有时间留给人际关系或家庭，甚至没有时间与理解她正在经历的事情的同龄人建立友谊——除了一些导师或合作者，比如钢琴家伊曼纽尔·阿克斯(Emanuel Ax)或作曲家泰迪·艾布拉姆斯(Teddy Abrams)，她最近与他们一起赢得了格莱美奖。尽管如此，她仍然给人一种热情洋溢的感觉，求知欲强，对她演奏的音乐有着深刻的理解。继续阅读...

title.en: Hong Kong's first leader after British handover dies
title.zh: 香港首任特首、英国移交后首位领导人董建华逝世

summary.en: Tung Chee-hwa, the first chief executive of Hong Kong after its handover from British to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89. His time in office, from 1997 to 2005, was characterized by significant challenges including the Asian Financial Crisis, two epidemics, and major protests.
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华（在英国将香港移交中国后）于周二晚逝世，享年89岁。他在1997年至2005年任职期间，经历了亚洲金融危机、两次重大疫情以及大规模抗议活动等严峻挑战。

body.en:
Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city returned to Chinese rule, has died at the age of 89.

The former shipping scion took over the reins from the last British Governor Chris Patten in July 1997 when the UK handed Hong Kong back to China , ending more than 150 years of British control.

Tung's rocky tenure was marked by the Asian Financial Crisis, two major epidemics, and historic protests which attracted criticism of his administration. He eventually resigned in 2005.

Tung died on Tuesday night surrounded by loved ones, local media reported. His office described him as a man "devoted to his country and its people".

Born in Shanghai in 1937, Tung graduated with a mechanical engineering degree from Liverpool University in the UK before moving to the US, where he worked at General Electric for almost a decade.

In 1969, he moved to Hong Kong and worked in his father's shipping conglomerate, the Orient Overseas, eventually taking over the reins in 1979.

His political career began in 1992 when he was appointed a member of Patten's executive council.

Despite having little political experience, Tung was believed to be handpicked by Beijing to lead Hong Kong after the handover. He was seen as a loyalist, especially after China's state-run banks helped rescue his family business during a global slump in the mid-1980s.

During a reception at the Great Hall of the People in January 1996, China's then-president Jiang Zemin walked across a packed room to shake Tung's hands – a widely photographed gesture that at the time famously signalled Beijing's backing of Tung for the top job.

The Asian Financial Crisis hit shortly after Tung took over, which sent home prices diving. His administration was also beset by a series of public health challenges, including a bird flu outbreak from 1997 to 2002 and the 2003 outbreak of Sars, also known as Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome.

But Tung's biggest political challenge took place in July 2003 during his second term, when half a million Hongkongers took to the streets to protest against a proposed national security law they feared would threaten their civic rights.

His administration abandoned the proposed legislation following the massive outcry, which also contributed to Tung stepping down in March 2005.

At the time his declining health was cited as a reason - but some said he was pressured by Beijing to step down.

Beijing ultimately imposed a national security law on Hong Kong in 2020, which authorities have argued is necessary to maintain stability. Critics however have called it "the end of Hong Kong" and say it has created a climate of fear in the city.
