title.en: Tributes flow in as Hong Kong mourns Tung Chee-hwa, pioneering first leader
title.zh: 香港悼念首任特首董建華，備受尊敬的長者

summary.en: Hong Kong is mourning the death of Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first leader after its return to Chinese sovereignty and a respected elder statesman, who died on Tuesday at the age of 89. Tung was surrounded by his family when he passed away peacefully.
summary.zh: 香港正在悼念董建華，這位在香港回歸中國主權後的首任行政長官、備受尊敬的長者，於週二逝世，享年89歲。據新華社報導，董建華在家人陪伴下安詳離世。

body.en: Hong Kong is mourning the death of Tung Chee-hwa, the city’s first leader after its return to Chinese sovereignty and a respected elder statesman, who died on Tuesday at the age of 89. Tung was surrounded by his family when he “passed away peacefully” at 9.57pm, according to state news agency Xinhua. Tributes and messages of grief poured in on Wednesday from across Hong Kong and mainland China, as well as from overseas, with top officials, politicians, business leaders and others praising his...
body.zh: 香港正在哀悼董建华的去世。董建华是香港回归中国后的首任领导人，也是一位受人尊敬的元老政治家。他于周二去世，享年 89 岁。据官方通讯社新华社报道，董建华于晚上 9 点 57 分在家人的簇拥下“安详离世”。周三，来自香港、中国大陆以及海外的悼念和哀悼信息纷纷涌来，高级官员、政界人士、商界领袖和其他人士赞扬了他的...

reflection.en: The news of Tung Chee-hwa's passing at 89 reminds us of the universal human experience of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 states that it is appointed for people to die once, and after this comes judgment. His life, like all lives, now rests in the hands of the Creator.
reflection.zh: 董建華以89歲高齡逝世的消息，提醒我們死亡是全人類共同的經歷。希伯來書9章27節指出，人人都有一死，死後且有審判。他的一生，如同所有生命一樣，如今都安息在創造主的手中。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Tung Chee-hwa hailed as visionary leader who helped build US-China relations
title.zh: 已故首任香港特首董建华被誉为“中国与美国关系中最伟大的推动者之一”

summary.en: Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who passed away on Tuesday, has been widely praised as a significant figure in China-US relations. A foundation linked to a former US president's family recognized his substantial contributions to strengthening ties between the two countries, a sentiment echoed by the...
summary.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华于周二逝世，他被广泛赞誉为中美关系中的重要人物。一个与美国前总统家族有关的基金会肯定了他为加强两国关系所做的重大贡献，这一评价也得到了美国领事馆和香港前特首曾荫权的回应。

body.en: Hong Kong’s first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, who died on Tuesday, has been lauded as “one of the greatest movers in China-US relations”, with a foundation established by a former American president’s family praising his “profound contributions” to deepening ties between the two nations. The US consulate and former city leader Donald Tsang Yam-kuen also praised Tung’s work in strengthening ties between the United States and Hong Kong, paving the way for deeper business links and high-level...
body.zh: 周二去世的香港首任特首董建华被誉为“中美关系最伟大的推动者之一”，美国前总统家族成立的基金会赞扬他对深化两国关系的“深远贡献”。美国领事馆和前香港领导人曾荫权也赞扬了董建华在加强美国与香港之间的联系方面所做的工作，为更深层次的商业联系和高层交往铺平了道路。

reflection.en: Tung Chee-hwa is remembered for his role in fostering connections between China and the United States. His efforts to deepen these international ties serve as a reminder of the value of building bridges and pursuing understanding between nations, even amidst complex global dynamics. May we all seek ways to promote peace and cooperation in our own spheres of...
reflection.zh: 董建华先生被铭记为在促进中国与美国之间联系方面所扮演的角色。他为深化这些国际关系所做的努力提醒我们，即使在全球局势复杂的情况下，建立桥梁和寻求国家间的理解也是有价值的。愿我们都能在我们各自的领域中寻求促进和平与合作的方式。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Two unlicensed tour guides arrested by authorities
title.zh: 两名无证导游被当局逮捕

summary.en: A mainland Chinese man and woman were arrested by immigration authorities on suspicion of working as unlicensed tour guides, violating their visa conditions. The Travel Industry Authority (TIA) conducted a joint operation with the Immigration Department, targeting unlicensed guides in Sai Kung. The TIA stated it would...
summary.zh: 一名内地男女因涉嫌担任无证导游而被入境事务处拘捕，违反了他们的逗留条件。旅游业监管局（TIA）与入境事务处联合执法，在西贡一带针对无证导游进行打击。该局表示，如证实两人违反了《旅游业条例》及相关规例，将对其提出检控。随着国庆黄金周临近，旅监局称将加强与其他部门的联合巡查，严厉执法。

body.en: A mainland man and woman have been arrested by immigration authorities on suspicion of working as unlicensed tour guides, in breach of their conditions of stay. In a statement, the Travel Industry Authority (TIA) said it conducted a joint operation with the Immigration Department on Monday and Tuesday, targeting unlicensed tour guides across Sai Kung's East Dam and Central. The industry watchdog added that it would also press charges if the pair is found to have breached the Travel Industry Ordinance and related regulations. With the National Day Golden Week holiday approaching, the TIA said it will step up joint inspections with other agencies to strictly enforce the Travel Industry Ordinance and protect the rights and interests of visitors. The authority also warned that anyone providing tour guide services without a valid licence faces a maximum fine of HK$50,000 and up to one year in prison. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 一名内地男子和一名女子因涉嫌违反逗留条件从事无证导游工作而被移民当局逮捕。旅游业监管局（TIA）在一份声明中表示，周一和周二与入境处联合采取行动，针对西贡东坝和中环的无证导游。该行业监管机构补充说，如果发现两人违反《旅游业条例》及相关法规，该行业监管机构也会提出指控。随着国庆黄金周假期临近，旅游局表示将与有关部门加强联合检查，严格执行《旅游业条例》，保障旅客权益。当局还警告称，任何没有有效执照而提供导游服务的人最高可被罚款5万港元及最高一年监禁。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The arrest of two individuals for working as unlicensed tour guides underscores the importance of operating within established rules and regulations. This situation calls to mind the prophet Micah's timeless instruction: 'He has shown you, O mortal, what is good. And what does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with...
reflection.zh: 两名无证导游被捕的事件，凸显了遵守既定规章制度的重要性。这让人想起先知弥迦的永恒教导：“世人啊，雅伟已指示你何为善。他要求你的是什么呢？是要行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与你的雅伟同行。” 维护公义意味着尊重那些旨在公平交易和保护所有相关人员的法律。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Consultants and contractors charged over Wang Fuk fire
title.zh: 王福火灾事故：顾问和承包商被控

summary.en: The Buildings Department has filed 259 charges against two companies and four individuals connected to last year's fire at Wang Fuk Court, which resulted in 168 fatalities. The firms involved are Will Power Architects Company and Prestige Construction & Engineering, along with four individuals, who face charges for...
summary.zh: 屋宇署周三表示，已对与去年王福庭火灾有关的两家公司和四名个人提出259项控罪，该火灾造成168人死亡。涉事公司为王福庭的翻新项目顾问公司Will Power Architects Company，以及总承建商Prestige Construction & Engineering。被起诉的四名个人包括Will...

body.en: The Buildings Department on Wednesday said it has laid 259 charges against two companies and four individuals linked to last year's fire at Wang Fuk Court, which took 168 lives. The two firms facing charges are Will Power Architects Company, the consultancy firm for the estate's renovation project, and Prestige Construction & Engineering, the main contractor. The four individuals prosecuted are Wong Hap-yin, director of Will Power; Ng Yeuk, the registered inspector engaged by the company; as well as Prestige directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. They're charged with allegedly permitting or authorising the use of defective materials or materials that do not comply with the provisions of the Buildings Ordinance in the carrying out of building works. The parties are also accused of permitting or authorising the building works to be carried out in a manner that caused injury to persons or property damage. The Buildings Department said it has stepped up regulation, inspection, and enforcement since the Wang Fuk Court inferno, while a special operation was launched to inspect scaffold nets and fire safety measures at about 400 buildings undergoing large-scale repair works across Hong Kong. Meanwhile, the Labour Department said it has prosecuted a project contractor, a consultant and an individual over the deaths of five workers in the Wang Fuk Court fire. It has instigated 25 charges for breaches of the general duty provisions under the Factories and Industrial Undertakings Ordinance. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 屋宇署周三表示，已对与去年宏福苑火灾有关的两家公司和四名个人提出 259 项指控，该火灾导致 168 人丧生。面临指控的两家公司是该庄园改造项目的咨询公司 Will Power Architects Company 和主承包商 Prestige Construction & Engineering。被检控的四人分别是Will Power董事黄合贤、 Ng Yeuk，该公司聘请的注册检验员；以及Prestige董事侯华健及何建业。他们被控涉嫌允许或授权在进行建筑工程时使用有缺陷的材料或不符合《建筑物条例》规定的材料。双方还被指控允许或授权以造成人身伤害或财产损失的方式进行建筑工程。屋宇署表示，宏福苑大火事件发生后，已加强监管、巡查和执法，并开展特别行动，检查全港约400栋正在进行大规模修葺工程的大厦的脚手架网和消防安全措施。与此同时，劳工处表示，已就宏福苑火灾导致五名工人死亡一事起诉一名工程承包商、一名顾问和一名个人。该局已就违反《工厂及工业经营条例》下的一般责任条文提出 25 项指控。杨雷蒙编辑

reflection.en: The charges brought against the companies and individuals involved in the Wang Fuk Court fire underscore the critical importance of accountability in construction and renovation projects. When safety standards are compromised, the consequences can be devastating, as seen in the tragic loss of 168 lives. This situation calls for a commitment to justice and...
reflection.zh: 对王福庭火灾事故所涉公司和个人提出的指控，凸显了在建筑和翻新工程中问责制的重要性。当安全标准受到损害时，后果可能是毁灭性的，正如168人生命的悲惨损失所示。这种情况呼唤对公正和道德实践的承诺，确保责任人受到追究，并防止此类可避免的悲剧重演。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Buildings Department files 259 charges over work at fire-ravaged Hong Kong estate
title.zh: 建筑署就焚毁的香港屋邨的工程提出259项检控

summary.en: Hong Kong's Buildings Department has filed 259 charges against two companies and four individuals for major renovation works at the Wang Fuk Court estate. Investigations revealed the use of non-fire-retardant materials and a failure to meet safety obligations.
summary.zh: 香港建筑署已就王福阁屋苑的重大翻新工程，向两家公司及四名个人提出259项检控。调查发现使用了不防火的材料，且未能履行安全义务。

body.en: Hong Kong’s Buildings Department has filed 259 charges against two companies and four individuals over repair works at the inferno-ravaged Wang Fuk Court, after investigations found non-fire-retardant materials were used and safety obligations were not met. The department said on Wednesday that the charges included allegedly permitting or authorising to be used in the carrying out of building works materials which are defective or did not comply with the provisions of the Buildings Ordinance, as...
body.zh: 香港屋宇署已就遭受大火蹂躏的宏福苑进行重大翻修工程，对两家公司和四名个人提出 259 项指控，调查发现使用了非阻燃材料且未履行安全义务。该部门周三表示，这些指控包括涉嫌允许或授权在进行建筑工程时使用有缺陷或不符合建筑物规定的材料......

reflection.en: The charges filed against companies and individuals for using substandard materials and neglecting safety obligations at Wang Fuk Court highlight a failure in accountability. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with our God, reminding us that ethical conduct and responsibility are paramount, especially when public safety is...
reflection.zh: 在王福阁屋苑的工程中，因使用不合格材料和忽视安全义务而对公司及个人提出的检控，凸显了问责制的缺失。《弥迦书》6章8节呼吁我们行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行，提醒我们道德行为和责任至关重要，尤其是在公共安全受到威胁之时。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 'Belt and Road Initiative yielding tangible outcomes'
title.zh: “一带一路倡议”取得切实成果

summary.en: Attendees at this year's Belt and Road Summit reported on Wednesday that the initiative, launched 13 years ago, is producing more 'tangible outcomes' as investment interest grows. Shaimerden Chikanayev, a lawyer from Kazakhstan, noted that Chief Executive John Lee's recent visit to Central Asia has stimulated business...
summary.zh: 本周三，出席今年“一带一路”峰会的与会者表示，这项13年前启动的标志性倡议正在产生更多“切实成果”，投资兴趣日益浓厚。哈萨克斯坦律师Shaimerden...

body.en: Visitors attending this year's Belt and Road Summit said on Wednesday that the signature initiative launched 13 years ago is yielding more "tangible outcomes" amid rising investment appetite. Shaimerden Chikanayev, a lawyer from Kazakhstan, said Chief Executive John Lee's visit to Central Asia earlier this year has sparked interest from businesses from both regions to expand trade and cooperation. He also said the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) has created "tangible projects" that have improved people's lives in his home country. "I think the Belt and Road Initiative is one of the best ideas," he said, recalling President Xi Jinping's announcement of the scheme during a speech in Astana in 2013. "At the beginning, there were not so many projects under Belt and Road Initiative. There was more talk than real business," he said. "[But] what I see is the difference now - we see more and more real projects. For example, if you go to Astana again, to my hometown, you will see the so-called light railway transport just commissioned this year. "It's really improving the lives of the people in Kazakhstan," he added. Chikanayev, who's pursuing a doctoral degree in Hong Kong, revealed that more Kazakh firms have prioritised fundraising or dispute resolution in the SAR over places like London. He cited Hong Kong's advantages in financing and its common law system, while being a gateway to the mainland. Sumit Dutta, from Thailand, said global companies seeking long-term, sustainable growth are doubling down on their investments in the Asean region in recent years. "I think the Belt and Road is, to me, it began with infrastructure, but I see it progressing far beyond," he said. "It's gradually evolving into a kind of Asian trade and investment event -- where of course China is at the forefront and infrastructure is at the forefront, but there's room for many other industries and many other markets to grow." The former banker who now runs a Singapore-based consultancy firm added that international firms also wish to tap into the region's fast-moving consumer markets. Separately, Michael Odhiambo, a Hong Kong-based entrepreneur originally from Kenya, said he hoped to expand his businesses in the "under-served markets" in Southeast Asia and Africa. "I think the [BRI] framework makes it easier [for us] to do business," he said. "It's easier to have a conversation about setting up shop in a different country as long as the initiatives are coming from the Belt and Road; it makes it much easier to have conversations with the stakeholders," he said. Edited by Raymond Yeung
body.zh: 参加今年“一带一路”峰会的与会者周三表示，随着投资兴趣的不断上升，13年前推出的这一标志性倡议正在产生更多“切实成果”。哈萨克斯坦律师谢梅尔登·奇卡纳耶夫表示，首席执行官李约翰今年早些时候对中亚的访问激发了两个地区企业扩大贸易与合作的兴趣。他还表示，“一带一路”倡议创造了“有形项目”，改善了祖国人民的生活。 “我认为‘一带一路’倡议是最好的想法之一，”他回忆起习近平主席2013年在阿斯塔纳发表讲话时宣布的这一计划。他说，“一开始，‘一带一路’倡议下的项目并不多。空谈多于实际业务。” “（但）我现在看到的是不同之处——我们看到了越来越多的实际项目。例如，如果你再去阿斯塔纳，回到我的家乡，你会看到今年刚刚投入使用的所谓轻轨交通。他补充道，“这确实改善了哈萨克斯坦人民的生活。”在香港攻读博士学位的奇卡纳耶夫透露，越来越多的哈萨克斯坦公司优先考虑在香港特别行政区筹集资金或解决争议，而不是伦敦等地。他引用了香港的说法来自泰国的苏米特·杜塔(Sumit Dutta)表示，香港在融资和普通法体系方面具有优势，同时也是通往内地的门户。近年来，寻求长期、可持续增长的全球企业正在加倍加大对东盟地区的投资。“我认为，‘一带一路’始于基础设施，但我看到它的发展远远超出了这一范围，”他说，“它正在逐渐演变成一种亚洲贸易和投资活动——当然，中国处于领先地位，但基础设施也处于领先地位。”这位现在经营一家新加坡咨询公司的前银行家补充道，国际公司也希望进入该地区快速发展的消费市场。另外，来自肯尼亚的香港企业家 Michael Odhiambo 表示，他希望在东南亚和非洲等“服务不足的市场”拓展业务。“我认为，[一带一路]框架使[我们]更容易开展业务，”他说。 “只要倡议来自‘一带一路’，就更容易讨论在不同国家开店的问题； “这使得与利益相关者的对话变得更加容易，”他说。编辑：Raymond Yeung

reflection.en: The Belt and Road Initiative, described as yielding 'tangible outcomes' and improving lives, reflects a human endeavor to foster connection and development. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. This principle invites reflection on how human initiatives, even those aimed at global...
reflection.zh: “一带一路”倡议被描述为取得“切实成果”并改善民生，这反映了人类为促进联系和发展所做的努力。箴言16:3鼓励我们将计划和工作交托给雅伟，并信靠祂必成就。这一原则促使我们反思，即使是旨在促进全球合作的人类倡议，也应如何根植于更高的目标和神的指引之中。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Buildings Dep’t launches 259 prosecutions over works at fire-hit Wang Fuk Court, 9 months after fatal blaze
title.zh: 王福苑火灾后九个月，屋宇署就失修单位展开259项检控

summary.en: Hong Kong's Buildings Department has initiated 259 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies responsible for renovation works at the fire-stricken Wang Fuk Court. The charges, filed over nine months after a deadly blaze killed 168 people, cite the use of substandard materials and inadequate supervision...
summary.zh: 香港屋宇署已对负责火灾中的王福苑单位翻新工程的四名个人和两家公司提起259项检控。这些指控在致命火灾造成168人死亡九个多月后提出，涉及使用劣质材料和翻新期间监督不力。

body.en: Hong Kong’s Buildings Department (BD) has launched more than 200 prosecutions against four individuals and two companies that oversaw renovation works at the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court. Wang Fuk Court. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The 259 charges, covering the use of defective or substandard materials and failure to adequately supervise renovation works, were initiated on Wednesday – more than nine months after the fire broke out. The prosecutions were launched after a joint investigation by the BD and the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit (ICU), the Wednesday statement said. The blaze at Wang Fuk Court, a government-subsidised housing estate in Tai Po, killed 168 people and displaced thousands of residents in November last year. Nine months on “The investigation revealed that the Registered Inspector (RI) employed by the project consultant failed to properly supervise the prescribed repair works and failed to ensure that the building was safe or had been rendered safe,” the department said on Wednesday “Meanwhile, during the course of the works, the main contractor and the project consultant allegedly permitted or authorised the use of non-fire-retardant scaffold netting and tarpaulins, as well as non-fire-retardant styrofoam boards to cover windows,” it continued. A tender analysis report signed off by Will Power director Wilson Ng in August 2023. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Fireproof windows along the emergency fire escape stairwell were also removed to create temporary access openings, causing smoke and fire to pour into the buildings and “ultimately resulting in 168 fatalities and 79 injuries,” the statement read. The two prosecuted companies are Will Power Architects, consultants for the estate’s HK$330 million renovation project, and the main contractor, Prestige Construction & Engineering. The four prosecuted individuals are Will Power’s director Wong Hap-yin and the inspector employed by the company, Wilson Ng, as well as Prestige’s two directors Hau Wa-kin and Ho Kin-yip. The same four people were also charged with a slew of offences in June, with Wong, Ng, Ho, and the two companies they represent facing manslaughter charges. ‘Widespread systemic issues’ Similar findings have previously been detailed in evidentiary hearings set up by an independent committee to probe the cause of the fire and its rapid spread. In March, the committee heard that the blaze revealed “ widespread systemic issues ” ranging from potential collusive tendering to rubber-stamp inspections and unauthorised proxy votes. The companies and the four individuals were discussed extensively at the hearings, though they did not testify in person. The blackened exterior of an apartment block in Wang Fuk Court, Tai Po, on November 27, 2025, with what appears...
body.zh: 香港屋宇署 (BD) 对负责监督遭受火灾的宏福苑翻修工程的四名个人和两家公司提起了 200 多项起诉。宏福苑.照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这 259 项指控是在火灾发生九个多月后于周三发起的，涉及使用有缺陷或不合格的材料以及未能充分监督翻修工程。周三的声明称，屋宇署和房屋局独立审查组（ICU）联合调查后提出检控。去年11月，大埔政府资助住宅小区宏福苑发生火灾，造成168人死亡，数千居民流离失所。九个月后，该部门周三表示，“调查显示，项目顾问聘用的注册检验员（RI）未能适当监督规定的维修工程，未能确保建筑物安全或已达到安全状态。”“与此同时，在工程过程中，总承包商和项目顾问据称允许或授权使用非阻燃脚手架网和防水油布，以及非阻燃聚苯乙烯泡沫板来覆盖窗户，”该部门继续说道。 Will Power 董事 Wilson Ng 于 2023 年 8 月签署的招标分析报告。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。声明称，紧急逃生楼梯间沿线的防火窗也被拆除，以形成临时通道，导致烟雾和火灾涌入建筑物，“最终导致 168 人死亡、79 人受伤”。两家被起诉的公司分别是该屋村耗资3.3亿港元翻新工程的顾问公司Will Power Architects，以及总承包商Prestige Construction & Engineering。四名被检控人士分别为Will Power董事黄合贤、该公司聘用的督察吴伟信，以及Prestige两名董事侯华健及何建业。六月，这四人还被指控犯有一系列罪行，其中黄、吴、何以及他们代表的两家公司面临过失杀人罪指控。 “广泛的系统性问题”此前，一个独立委员会为调查火灾原因及其迅速蔓延而设立的证据听证会详细介绍了类似的调查结果。今年三月，委员会听说火灾暴露了“广泛的系统性问题”，从潜在的串通投标到橡皮图章检查和未经授权的代理投票。尽管这些公司和这四人没有亲自作证，但他们在听证会上进行了广泛讨论。 2025 年 11 月 27 日，大埔宏福苑一栋公寓楼的外墙被熏黑，看上去……

reflection.en: The tragedy at Wang Fuk Court, which claimed 168 lives, highlights a profound failure in accountability. The subsequent launch of 259 prosecutions points to a system grappling with the consequences of negligence and the use of substandard materials. This situation calls us to reflect on the importance of integrity and diligence in all our undertakings,...
reflection.zh: 王福苑的悲剧夺走了168条生命，这暴露了问责制的严重缺失。随后发起的259项检控表明，相关系统正在应对疏忽大意和使用劣质材料所带来的后果。这种情况促使我们反思，在所有事业中，尤其是在那些影响他人安全和福祉的事业中，诚信和勤勉的重要性。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Washington accuses Chinese AI firms of ‘systematic’ theft
title.zh: 华盛顿指控中国人工智能公司“系统性”盗窃

summary.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs, including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday, amidst a race for technological supremacy between the two countries. This advisory from the US cyber defense agency precedes a potential meeting...
summary.zh: 周二，华盛顿指控包括 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI...

body.en: Washington accused top Chinese artificial intelligence labs including DeepSeek and Moonshot AI of systematically stealing the capabilities of American models on Tuesday as the two countries race for tech supremacy. Chinese startup DeepSeek’s AI assistant. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. The advisory from the US cyber defense agency comes ahead of an expected meeting this month between President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the White House, where AI could be an important discussion topic. It follows several previous accusations of Chinese AI theft through a process known as distillation, levelled by the US government and American AI companies. “China-based artificial intelligence (AI) companies are conducting systematic extraction of proprietary functionalities and capabilities of US AI companies’ models,” Tuesday’s advisory read. They are doing so “through industrial-scale knowledge distillation campaigns that form the core — not merely a supplement — of their AI development strategy”, it said. OpenAI, the creator of ChatGPT. Photo: Levart_Photographer/Unsplash. Distillation is where an AI model is trained to mimic the output of a larger, more capable one. The method is widely used across the industry, but Washington says Chinese firms have deployed it at scale to illicitly copy American systems. Chinese companies that adopt this strategy “see significantly shorter AI development timelines and reduced financial expenditures in training a frontier model”, the advisory said. It detailed how DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, MiniMax, StepFun, and Z.AI allegedly used millions of exchanges and requests to steal the capabilities of US models from the likes of OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and xAI. These actions, taken “likely with Chinese government awareness”, have taken place since at least late 2024, it said. AFP contacted the Chinese companies apart from StepFun which was not immediately reachable. Moonshot AI declined to comment. ‘Smearing China’ Trump is under pressure to respond to the increasing success of Chinese AI models that many companies prefer to the more powerful, but pricier, US versions from Anthropic or OpenAI. In July, dozens of startups wrote a letter to the Trump administration urging it to think twice against any outright ban or strict curbs on foreign-made AI models, saying this should only be considered for government use of the technology. That month, Beijing also turned the tables by accusing US AI of using Chinese examples to train their models. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Beijing, China. Photo: Wikicommons. Asked about the accusations at a regular briefing Wednesday, Chinese foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said...
body.zh: 周二，在两国争夺技术霸主之际，华盛顿指责 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 等中国顶尖人工智能实验室系统性窃取美国模型的能力。中国初创公司 DeepSeek 的人工智能助手。资料照片：Kelly Ho/HKFP。美国网络防御机构的这一建议是在唐纳德·特朗普总统和中国国家主席习近平预计本月在白宫举行会议之前发布的，人工智能可能成为重要的讨论话题。在此之前，美国政府和美国人工智能公司曾多次指控中国通过“蒸馏”过程盗窃人工智能。周二的咨询报告称：“中国的人工智能（AI）公司正在系统地提取美国人工智能公司模型的专有功能和能力。”报告称，他们正在“通过工业规模的知识提炼活动来实现这一目标，这些活动构成了其人工智能发展战略的核心，而不仅仅是补充”。 OpenAI，ChatGPT 的创建者。照片：Levart_Photographer/Unsplash。蒸馏是训练人工智能模型来模仿更大、能力更强的模型的输出。该方法在整个行业广泛使用，但华盛顿表示，中国公司已大规模部署该方法来非法复制美国系统。该咨询称，采用这一策略的中国公司“发现人工智能开发时间明显缩短，培训前沿模型的财务支出也减少了”。它详细介绍了 DeepSeek、Moonshot AI、阿里巴巴、MiniMax、StepFun 和 Z.AI 据称如何利用数百万次交换和请求从 OpenAI、Anthropic、谷歌和 xAI 等公司窃取美国模型的功能。报告称，这些行动“可能是在中国政府意识到的情况下”采取的，至少自 2024 年底以来就已采取。法新社联系了除StepFun之外的其他中国公司，但未能立即联系上。 Moonshot AI 拒绝置评。 “抹黑中国” 特朗普面临着应对中国人工智能模型日益成功的压力，许多公司更喜欢中国人工智能模型，而不是 Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的更强大但价格更高的美国版本。今年 7 月，数十家初创公司写信给特朗普政府，敦促其三思而后行，反对对外国制造的人工智能模型的任何彻底禁令或严格限制，并表示只有政府使用该技术才应考虑这样做。当月，北京还指责美国人工智能使用中国的例子来训练他们的模型，从而扭转了局势。位于中国北京的外交部。照片：维基共享资源。中国外交部发言人毛宁在周三的例行吹风会上被问及这些指控时表示……

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence, as highlighted by accusations of capability theft between nations, speaks to a time when 'knowledge will increase' (Daniel 12:4). This technological race, while fraught with ethical concerns and competition, also represents humanity's relentless pursuit of understanding and innovation. May we seek wisdom to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，如国家间关于能力窃取的指控所示，正应验了“知识将增添”（但以理书 12:4）的预言。这场技术竞赛虽然充满伦理担忧和竞争，但也代表了人类对理解和创新的不懈追求。愿我们寻求智慧来引导这些强大的工具服务于人类的繁荣，而非加剧分裂。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...

title.en: Long-lost fish species rediscovered in another section of the Inn River
title.zh: 失落已久的鱼类物种在印河另一段被重新发现

summary.en: The Danube gudgeon, a species thought to be extinct in the Inn River for over 100 years, has been rediscovered. Researchers from the Technical University of Munich documented the fish in a different section of the Inn as part of a project studying the ecological impact of fishways.
summary.zh: 曾被认为在印河中灭绝超过100年的多瑙河鲦鱼已被重新发现。慕尼黑工业大学的研究人员在印河的另一段记录到了这种鱼，这是作为一项研究鱼道对鱼类种群和河流生态系统影响项目的一部分。

Now, researchers at the Technical University of Munich (TUM) have documented the fish in another section of the Inn. The finding emerged from a joint research project with hydropower operator VERBUND examining the effects of nature-like fishways on fish populations and river ecology.

title.en: Helium measurements clarify conditions seconds after the Big Bang
title.zh: 氦测量澄清宇宙大爆炸后几秒钟的条件

summary.en: New observations of the composition of distant galaxies offer insights into the earliest phases of the universe and confirm decades of scientific understanding of the elements and particles produced by the Big Bang, according to a new study.
summary.zh: 根据一项新研究，对遥远星系组成的最新观测为了解宇宙的早期阶段提供了见解，并证实了数十年来关于大爆炸产生的元素和粒子的科学理解。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

New observations of the composition of distant galaxies offer insights into the earliest phases of the universe and confirm decades of scientific understanding of the elements and particles produced by the Big Bang, according to a new study.

Researchers used data from The Large Binocular Telescope (LBT) to measure the amount of helium—the second-most common element in the cosmos and a vital ingredient for the formation of life—in metal-poor nebulae, clouds of gas and dust in space where stars are sometimes born. Their findings strengthen long-held theories about how ancient elements, such as carbon and nitrogen, may have been dispersed in the period following the Big Bang.

Astronomers did this by analyzing helium signals in optical and infrared light to determine the temperature and density of the gases within faraway systems. After collecting 48 high-quality galactic samples, the team created a dataset aimed at significantly expanding researchers' ability to infer the universe's primordial helium abundance.

"Everything that we need to live here on Earth was once fused inside a star," said Miqaela Weller, lead author of the study and a Ph.D. student in astronomy at The Ohio State University. "Understanding precisely where those elements come from helps inform us about how our universe evolved and how it will evolve in the future."

The study was recently published as part of a series of papers in The Astrophysical Journal.

The work was completed as part of the LBT Yp project, a collaboration designed to accurately determine how much primordial helium was created at the universe's beginning, an amount theorized to be largely dependent on the types of neutrinos, tiny and abundant subatomic particles, that were likely formed when the universe was only one second old.

If, for example, the amount of helium found in metal-poor galaxies is vastly different from astronomers' current predictions, their results might challenge current theories about the universe's early conditions and open the door to new, undiscovered physics, said Weller, who leads the infrared data reduction for the project.

Still, it can be extremely difficult to peer into the universe's past, as astronomers can see only as far back as about 400,000 years after the Big Bang, when the universe became transparent enough to form the cosmic microwave background (CMB). Thus, by comparing their new observations with archival observations of the CMB, they can determine whether current models of the universe are accurate.

"The importance of galactic archaeology cannot be understated," said Weller. "The stars...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一项新的研究表明，对遥远星系组成的新观测提供了对宇宙最早阶段的见解，并证实了数十年来对大爆炸产生的元素和粒子的科学理解。 研究人员利用大型双目望远镜（LBT）的数据测量了贫金属星云、有时诞生恒星的太空中的气体云和尘埃中氦的含量，氦是宇宙中第二常见的元素，也是生命形成的重要成分。他们的发现强化了长期以来关于碳和氮等古代元素在大爆炸之后的时期如何分散的理论。 天文学家通过分析光学和红外光中的氦信号来确定遥远系统内气体的温度和密度来做到这一点。在收集了 48 个高质量的星系样本后，该团队创建了一个数据集，旨在显着扩展研究人员推断宇宙原始氦丰度的能力。 “我们在地球上生活所需的一切都曾经融合在恒星内部，”该研究的主要作者、博士生米盖拉·韦勒 (Miqaela Weller) 说。俄亥俄州立大学天文学专业的学生。 “准确了解这些元素的来源有助于我们了解宇宙如何演化以及未来将如何演化。” 该研究最近作为系列论文的一部分发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。 这项工作是作为 LBT Yp 项目的一部分完成的，该项目旨在准确确定在宇宙诞生之初产生了多少原始氦，理论上这个量很大程度上取决于中微子的类型，即微小而丰富的亚原子粒子，这些粒子很可能是在宇宙只有一秒大的时候形成的。 例如，如果在贫金属星系中发现的氦含量与天文学家当前的预测有很大不同，他们的结果可能会挑战当前关于宇宙早期条件的理论，并为新的、未被发现的物理学打开大门，负责该项目红外数据缩减的韦勒说。 尽管如此，窥视宇宙的过去还是极其困难的，因为天文学家只能看到大爆炸后约 40 万年前的情况，当时宇宙变得足够透明，足以形成宇宙微波背景 (CMB)。因此，通过将他们的新观测结果与宇宙微波背景的档案观测结果进行比较，他们可以确定当前的宇宙模型是否准确。 “银河考古学的重要性不可低估，”韦勒说。 “星星...

reflection.en: The vastness of the cosmos and the intricate laws governing its formation, as revealed by new astronomical observations, echo the ancient wisdom that creation itself declares the glory and intelligence of its Maker. Studying the universe's earliest moments, like the abundance of helium, invites us to ponder the profound order and design evident in all of...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚及其形成所依据的复杂法则，正如新的天文观测所揭示的那样，呼应了古老的智慧：被造物本身就宣告了其创造者的荣耀和智慧。研究宇宙的早期时刻，例如氦的丰度，引导我们思考存在的一切事物中显而易见的深刻秩序和设计。...

title.en: You can't shield kids from scary news—here's what 'Sesame Street' and other children's shows did after 9/11
title.zh: 你无法让孩子远离可怕的新闻——以下是“芝麻街”等儿童节目在9/11事件后所做的

summary.en: A parent recounts their shock in 2005 upon seeing their first-grade son's drawing of the 9/11 attacks, illustrating how children can retain and process memories of significant, often traumatic, news events, and how media like 'Sesame Street' responded to help them cope.
summary.zh: 一位家长回忆起2005年参加一年级儿子的家长晚会时，看到儿子画的9/11袭击事件的图画，这说明了孩子们如何能够保留和处理重大、往往是创伤性新闻事件的记忆，以及像“芝麻街”这样的媒体如何应对以帮助他们应对。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

On back-to-school night in 2005, I eagerly entered my youngest child's first-grade classroom. The walls were festooned with brightly colored responses to the prompt: "Draw something you remember."

I scanned for my son's picture and was shocked when I encountered his drawing: an airplane flying into New York's World Trade Center.

"I saw the picture you drew up on the bulletin board," I said to him later that night. "Do you really remember seeing planes flying into the twin towers?"

He looked me in the eyes and replied, "No, Mommy. But I do remember you crying."

My son was not quite 2 years old on Sept. 11, 2001. As a mother, I despaired to learn that my own reaction to that day's tragedies had stuck with him so viscerally. As a professor and researcher of children's media, I shouldn't have been surprised.

My son's memory was likely influenced not just by my emotional reaction but by the media around him that his parents and siblings consumed in the weeks and years after the attacks—a mix of TV news and content geared toward kids.

More than two decades later, children have many more ways and platforms to encounter frightening images and stories, often without an adult nearby to help them make sense of what they see. But the ways children's programming such as " Sesame Street " responded to 9/11 offer a useful lesson: Rather than trying to shield children completely from disturbing events, adults can help them process what they've seen in honest, reassuring and age-appropriate ways.

Psychologist Joanne Cantor was one of the first to study what scares children about news and how they respond to it.

She concluded that what frightens children varies by their developmental stage . Younger children tend to notice and respond to stories about natural disasters and tragedies involving kids or animals. Older children are afraid of stories focusing on personal injury and physical destruction, kidnapping, disease and violence. Teens express fear of stories about random acts of violence, natural disasters and foreign conflicts.

Since Cantor first published her groundbreaking research in the 1980s, kids' media environments have changed dramatically, with more channels, screens and platforms broadcasting images and videos of natural disasters, violence and tragedies from around the world.

One study found that young children's exposure to news is often accidental but lasting, with many children recalling distressing images long after the fact. Another one found that violent news images take a cumulative toll on children's mental and emotional health. And an international survey...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 2005年返校的夜晚，我迫不及待地走进我最小的孩子一年级的教室。墙上挂满了色彩鲜艳的提示：“画一些你记得的东西。” 我扫描了儿子的照片，当我看到他的画时，我感到震惊：一架飞机飞向纽约世贸中心。 “我看到了你在布告栏上画的照片，”那天晚上我对他说。 “你真的记得看到飞机飞进双子塔吗？” 他看着我的眼睛回答道：“不，妈妈。但我确实记得你哭过。” 2001 年 9 月 11 日，我的儿子还不到两岁。作为一名母亲，我绝望地发现我自己对那天悲剧的反应深深地印在了他的心上。作为一名儿童媒体教授和研究员，我不应该感到惊讶。 我儿子的记忆可能不仅受到我的情绪反应的影响，还受到他的父母和兄弟姐妹在袭击发生后数周乃至数年里所消费的媒体的影响——电视新闻和面向儿童的内容的混合体。 二十多年后，孩子们有更多的方式和平台来遇到可怕的图像和故事，而通常没有成年人在身边帮助他们理解所看到的内容。但《芝麻街》等儿童节目应对 9/11 事件的方式提供了一个有用的教训：成年人不必试图完全保护儿童免受令人不安的事件的影响，而是可以帮助他们以诚实、放心和适合年龄的方式处理所看到的事情。 心理学家乔安妮·坎托（Joanne Cantor）是最早研究孩子们对新闻感到恐惧以及他们如何反应的人之一。 她的结论是，孩子们害怕的东西因他们的发展阶段而异。年幼的孩子往往会注意到并回应涉及儿童或动物的自然灾害和悲剧的故事。年龄较大的孩子害怕关注人身伤害和身体破坏、绑架、疾病和暴力的故事。青少年对有关随机暴力行为、自然灾害和外国冲突的故事表示恐惧。 自从 Cantor 在 20 世纪 80 年代首次发表突破性研究以来，孩子们的媒体环境发生了巨大变化，越来越多的频道、屏幕和平台播放来自世界各地的自然灾害、暴力和悲剧的图像和视频。 一项研究发现，幼儿接触新闻往往是偶然的，但却是持久的，许多孩子在事后很久都会回忆起令人痛苦的画面。另一项研究发现，暴力新闻图片对儿童的心理和情绪健康造成累积损害。还有一项国际调查...

reflection.en: Children are not shielded from the world's events, even years later. The memory of the 9/11 attacks, depicted in a first-grader's drawing, shows how deeply such news can impact young minds. This reminds us of the profound responsibility to guide children, helping them understand and process difficult realities with age-appropriate care and wisdom.
reflection.zh: 孩子们无法远离世界发生的事件，即使多年之后也是如此。9/11袭击事件的记忆，体现在一名一年级学生的画作中，显示了这些新闻对年幼心灵的深刻影响。这提醒我们，我们肩负着指导孩子的重大责任，帮助他们以适合年龄的关怀和智慧来理解和处理困难的现实。

verse.textEn: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: AI reveals new class of cellular 'off switch' linked to cancer pathways
title.zh: 人工智能揭示与癌症通路相关的新型细胞“关闭开关”

summary.en: Cornell researchers have employed artificial intelligence to discover a previously unknown mechanism by which cells regulate protein movement internally. This process is crucial for cellular functions like growth, communication, and movement, and its dysregulation is frequently implicated in cancer.
summary.zh: 康奈尔大学的研究人员利用人工智能发现了一种先前未知的细胞调控蛋白质在细胞内移动的方式。这一过程对细胞的生长、交流和运动至关重要，并且其失调常常与癌症有关。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Cornell researchers have used artificial intelligence to uncover a previously unknown way cells control how proteins move inside them, a process essential for growth, communication and movement that is often disrupted in cancer.

The study, published Sept. 9 in the Journal of Cell Biology , shows that a little-understood protein called Avl9 acts as an "off switch" for another protein, Arf1, which helps direct where materials go inside cells. Turning Arf1 off at the right time is critical because it regulates cellular transport; otherwise, cells become disorganized, leading to negative effects. The researchers also found that Avl9 is part of a broader group of proteins that may perform the same function, pointing to a previously unrecognized system cells use to keep this process in balance.

Led by Chris Fromme, professor of molecular biology and genetics at the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences and a faculty member at the Weill Institute for Cell and Molecular Biology, the team used AlphaFold , an artificial intelligence program that predicts the structures of proteins and how they might interact, to search for previously unknown partners of Arf1.

Instead of traditional lab screening, which can take months, the AI software quickly generated a shortlist of likely protein interactions for experimental testing.

"We discovered an unexpected function of a poorly understood protein, which helps us understand how cells control intracellular trafficking," Fromme said.

Arf1 acts as a molecular switch that directs the movement of proteins and other cargo to the right places inside the cell. Because it is involved in many essential processes, scientists expected additional proteins to exist to control its activity.

"Arf1 controls the movement of proteins that need to move from the Golgi to several other destinations in the cell," Fromme said. "Arf1 is essential for many cellular behaviors, including secretion, migration and basic internal organization."

"Arf1 is so important and involved in so many different cellular pathways, we felt there had to be more to how cells control its activity than what was already known," he said.

The AI analysis pointed to Avl9, which had been linked to secretion and cancer cell movement but whose function was unknown. Laboratory experiments confirmed that Avl9 shuts down Arf1 after it has carried out its role.

"The function of Avl9 was the exact opposite of what you would guess based on what was known about its amino acid composition," said Ryan Vignogna, postdoctoral associate at the Weill Institute and first author of the study.

As we uncover more about cellular processes, like this new 'off switch' for protein movement, we see how knowledge expands, echoing the ancient prophecy that in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.'...

title.en: Body-related TikTok content linked to self-objectification and mood
title.zh: 与身体相关的TikTok内容与自我物化和情绪相关

summary.en: A new study published in PLOS One by Samantha Jones and colleagues at Western University indicates that viewing "thinspiration" content on TikTok leads to increased self-objectification and a worse mood. Conversely, while body-positive content also increases self-objectification, it is associated with a more positive...
summary.zh: 发表在PLOS One上的一项由加拿大西安大略大学的萨曼莎·琼斯及其同事进行的新研究表明，在TikTok上观看“瘦身励志”内容会增加自我物化并导致情绪变差。相反，虽然身体积极的内容也会增加自我物化，但它与更积极的情绪相关。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Viewing "thinspiration" content on TikTok increases self-objectification and worsens mood, while viewing body-positive content also increases self-objectification but is linked to a more positive mood, according to a new study published in PLOS One by Samantha Jones of Western University, Canada, and colleagues.

Self-objectification occurs when people feel their value is determined by their appearance, viewing themselves and their bodies as objects. Appearance-focused social media content includes thinspiration, which depicts a thin ideal and promotes weight loss; fitspiration, which contains fat-loss-promoting messages; and body positivity content, which promotes body acceptance and challenges thin and fit ideals.

Recently, researchers have questioned the beneficial nature of body positivity content, as well as the overall associations between self-objectification and mood.

In the new study, researchers recruited 323 women and feminine-identifying people who reported their general disposition to self-objectify before watching a randomized set of 20 TikTok videos spanning five categories: thinspiration, fitspiration, body positivity, general positive and neutral. After each video, participants reported their self-objectification and mood levels.

Compared with watching positive videos, self-objectification was highest after viewing thinspiration (B = 1.24), followed by body-positive (B = 0.98) and fitspiration (B = 0.43) content. Thinspiration and fitspiration were both associated with increased negative mood and decreased positive mood compared with neutral videos.

Body-positive content, on the other hand, was associated with increased positive mood. Greater self-objectification after viewing body-positive content strengthened this positive mood effect (B = 6.49).

The study measured only momentary effects of viewing videos, so it cannot determine longer-term effects, and participants did not complete a baseline mood or self-objectification measure before viewing videos. The sample was young and consisted largely of women of average body size, limiting generalizability.

However, the researchers conclude that appearance-focused social media content broadly increases self-objectification, but this is not always associated with negative outcomes. Future research could probe how to lessen the effects of thinspiration and fitspiration on mood, they say, especially for those with a high tendency to self-objectify.

The authors add, "We found that women experienced negative emotions when viewing social media videos that idealize thinness. Women who tend to value their...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 加拿大西部大学的 Samantha Jones 及其同事在 PLOS One 上发表的一项新研究表明，在 TikTok 上观看“瘦身”内容会增加自我客体化，并使情绪恶化，而观看积极身体的内容也会增加自我客体化，但与更积极的情绪有关。 当人们觉得自己的价值是由外表决定的，并将自己和身体视为物体时，就会出现自我客体化。以外表为中心的社交媒体内容包括“thinspiration”，它描绘了苗条的理想并促进减肥； fitspiration，其中包含促进减脂的信息；以及身体积极性内容，促进身体接受度并挑战苗条和健康的理想。 最近，研究人员质疑身体积极性内容的有益性质，以及自我客体化和情绪之间的整体关联。 在这项新研究中，研究人员招募了 323 名女性和具有女性特征的人，她们在随机观看 20 个 TikTok 视频之前报告了自己自我客观化的总体倾向，这些视频涵盖五个类别：瘦灵感、健身、身体积极性、一般积极性和中性。每个视频结束后，参与者都会报告他们的自我客观化和情绪水平。 与观看正面视频相比，观看“thinspiration”（B = 1.24）后，自我客体化程度最高，其次是“身体正面”（B = 0.98）和“fitspiration”（B = 0.43）内容。与中性视频相比，Thinspiration 和 Fitspiration 都与消极情绪增加和积极情绪减少相关。 另一方面，身体积极的内容与积极情绪的增加有关。观看对身体积极的内容后，更大的自我客体化强化了这种积极的情绪效应（B = 6.49）。 该研究仅测量了观看视频的短暂影响，因此无法确定长期影响，并且参与者在观看视频之前没有完成基线情绪或自我客观化测量。样本很年轻，主要由平均体型的女性组成，限制了普遍性。 然而，研究人员得出的结论是，以外表为中心的社交媒体内容广泛增加了自我客体化，但这并不总是与负面结果相关。他们说，未来的研究可能会探讨如何减轻稀薄的吸气和适合的吸气对情绪的影响，特别是对于那些具有高度自我客体化倾向的人。 作者补充道，“我们发现，女性在观看理想化苗条的社交媒体视频时会经历负面情绪。那些倾向于重视自己的……的女性

The Apostle Paul urges believers to focus their minds on whatever is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, admirable, excellent, or praiseworthy. This practice helps guard our hearts and minds against the distortions that can arise from constant exposure to...

title.en: 'Here, There and Everywhere': The Beatles have permeated research papers across academic disciplines
title.zh: “无处不在”：披头士乐队的歌曲渗透到各个学科的研究论文中

summary.en: A study published in PLOS One reveals that over 3,000 scientific article titles across various disciplines have incorporated titles and lyrics from The Beatles. This analysis represents an extensive, cross-disciplinary examination of the band's influence on scientific writing, demonstrating how researchers frequently...
summary.zh: 发表在《公共科学图书馆·综合》上的一项研究显示，在不同学科的科学论文标题中，有超过3000篇引用了披头士乐队的歌曲名称和歌词。这项分析是对披头士乐队对科学写作影响的一次前所未有的大规模跨学科考察，表明研究人员经常借鉴文化符号来构建他们的研究。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

More than 3,000 scientific article titles across disciplines have made use of Beatles song titles and lyrics, according to a study published in PLOS One by Gabriel Budel of Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands and colleagues. This analysis is an unprecedentedly large-scale, cross-disciplinary account of how the Beatles have left their mark on scientific writing.

Researchers routinely draw on cultural touchstones to frame their work, and popular music in particular has left a distinct mark on academic publishing. Of all musical artists to have influenced scientific communication in this way, the Beatles may be among the most pervasive.

In the new study, Budel and colleagues examined how often Beatles song titles and lyrics appear in academic article titles. The researchers identified 2,237 exact references and 963 instances of creative wordplay in data from the academic database Scopus.

Using a curated list of Beatles songs and lyrics, they combined automated title queries with state-of-the-art large language models to detect both exact references and wordplay across disciplines.

The analysis revealed that the references are not confined to any single field. Medicine and the social sciences dominate, but the long tail reaches fields as varied as computer science, economics, environmental science, and the arts and humanities.

In addition, the top 10 Beatles song titles appear in 1,584 article titles, more than the equivalent top 10s of Michael Jackson (65 articles) and Elvis Presley (196 articles), the next two best-selling artists.

The most frequently referenced song titles—"The Long and Winding Road" (798 hits), "With a Little Help from My Friends" (209 hits), and "Here, There and Everywhere" (129 hits)—are apt metaphors for the scientific process, including the course of research, collaboration, and discovery.

Many variations on "All You Need Is Love" made their way into the academic literature, such as "All you need is sleep." The 2017 article "Attention is all you need" is one of the most influential scientific publications of the 21st century to date. It was cited 89,737 times on Scopus.

As noted by the researchers, there is a clear practical lesson for authors: A well-chosen cultural reference can make a technical contribution more memorable, as long as the allusion fits the content without sacrificing clarity for readers or discoverability in literature searches.

The same titles can help editors and science communicators reach past a specialist audience, since a shared cultural touchstone travels easily between fields. Overall, the study...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 荷兰代尔夫特理工大学的 Gabriel Budel 及其同事在 PLOS One 上发表的一项研究显示，超过 3,000 篇跨学科的科学文章标题使用了披头士乐队的歌曲标题和歌词。这项分析是对披头士乐队如何在科学写作上留下印记的前所未有的大规模、跨学科的描述。 研究人员经常利用文化试金石来构建他们的工作，尤其是流行音乐在学术出版上留下了独特的印记。在所有以这种方式影响科学传播的音乐艺术家中，披头士乐队可能是最普遍的一位。 在这项新研究中，布德尔和同事研究了披头士乐队歌曲标题和歌词出现在学术文章标题中的频率。研究人员从学术数据库 Scopus 的数据中识别出 2,237 个准确的参考文献和 963 个创意双关语实例。 他们使用披头士乐队歌曲和歌词的精选列表，将自动标题查询与最先进的大型语言模型相结合，以检测跨学科的确切引用和文字游戏。 分析表明，参考文献并不局限于任何单一领域。医学和社会科学占主导地位，但长尾涉及计算机科学、经济学、环境科学以及艺术和人文学科等各个领域。 此外，披头士乐队的前 10 首歌曲出现在 1,584 篇文章标题中，超过了排在其后的两位畅销艺术家迈克尔·杰克逊（65 篇）和埃尔维斯·普雷斯利（196 篇）的前 10 名歌曲。 最常被引用的歌曲标题——“漫长而曲折的道路”（798 首点击）、“With a Little Help from My Friends”（209 首点击）和“Here、There and Everywhere”（129 首点击）——都是科学过程的恰当隐喻，包括研究、合作和发现的过程。 “你所需要的就是爱”的许多变体都进入了学术文献，例如“你所需要的就是睡眠”。 2017年的文章《Attention is all you need》是21世纪迄今为止最具影响力的科学出版物之一。 Scopus 上引用了 89,737 次。 正如研究人员所指出的，这对作者来说是一个明确的实践教训：只要典故符合内容，而又不牺牲读者的清晰度或文献搜索的可发现性，精心选择的文化参考可以使技术贡献更令人难忘。 相同的标题可以帮助编辑和科学传播者接触到专业受众，因为共同的文化试金石可以轻松地在不同领域之间传播。总体而言，该研究...

Daniel 12:4 foretold a time when 'many would run to and fro, and knowledge would increase.' This phenomenon shows how human culture, even in its artistic expressions, can become woven into the fabric of our...

title.en: Scientists find a bone-building switch that could fight osteoporosis
title.zh: 科学家发现骨骼生长开关，或可对抗骨质疏松症

summary.en: Researchers have identified an experimental compound, AP503, that significantly strengthens bones in mice by activating the GPR133 receptor, which promotes bone formation and reduces bone loss. This discovery holds potential for new osteoporosis treatments, especially as existing therapies have limitations and side...
summary.zh: 研究人员发现一种名为AP503的实验性化合物，通过激活GPR133受体，显著增强了小鼠的骨骼，该受体可促进骨骼形成并减缓骨骼流失。这一发现为骨质疏松症的新疗法带来了潜力，尤其考虑到现有疗法存在局限性和副作用。该化合物也显示出增强肌肉的潜力。

body.en:
Osteoporosis, a condition that weakens bones and increases the risk of fractures, affects millions of people and remains a major challenge for doctors seeking safe treatments that can be used over long periods. In Germany alone, about six million people are affected, most of them women.

Because existing therapies can have limitations and side effects, researchers are looking for new biological targets that could lead to more effective ways of preserving or rebuilding bone. Scientists at Leipzig University have now identified one such target in GPR133, a receptor that appears to play an important role in keeping bones strong.

GPR133 belongs to a group known as adhesion G protein-coupled receptors. These receptors sit on the surface of cells and help them respond to signals from their surroundings. Although this family of receptors is still not fully understood, the new findings suggest GPR133 is closely involved in the processes that build and maintain healthy bone.

"If this receptor is impaired by genetic changes, mice show signs of loss of bone density at an early age - similar to osteoporosis in humans. Using the substance AP503, which was only recently identified via a computer-assisted screen as a stimulator of GPR133, we were able to significantly increase bone strength in both healthy and osteoporotic mice," explains Professor Ines Liebscher, lead investigator of the study from the Rudolf Schönheimer Institute of Biochemistry at the Faculty of Medicine.

The results point to GPR133 as a potentially valuable target for future osteoporosis treatments. The researchers found that stimulating the receptor with AP503 increased bone strength not only in healthy mice, but also in mice with osteoporosis-like bone loss.

Inside bone tissue, GPR133 responds to physical forces and interactions between nearby bone cells. When the receptor is activated, it sets off signaling that changes the balance between the cells that build bone and those that break it down.

Bone-forming cells (osteoblasts) are responsible for producing new bone tissue. Bone-resorbing cells (osteoclasts), by contrast, remove old bone as part of the skeleton's normal cycle of renewal. Healthy bones depend on maintaining the right balance between these two processes.

Activation of GPR133 encourages the activity of osteoblasts while reducing the activity of osteoclasts. This shifts the balance toward stronger and more durable bone.

AP503 appears to imitate the natural process that activates GPR133. That raises the possibility that the compound could eventually be used to increase bone strength or help restore bone that has already been weakened. One potential application would be osteoporosis associated with menopause, when declining hormone levels can accelerate bone loss in...
body.zh: 骨质疏松症是一种削弱骨骼并增加骨折风险的疾病，影响数百万人，对于寻求可长期使用的安全治疗方法的医生来说仍然是一个重大挑战。仅在德国，就有约 600 万人受到影响，其中大多数是女性。 由于现有疗法可能存在局限性和副作用，研究人员正在寻找新的生物靶点，以找到更有效的保存或重建骨骼的方法。莱比锡大学的科学家现已在 GPR133 中发现了一个这样的靶标，GPR133 是一种似乎在保持骨骼强健方面发挥重要作用的受体。 GPR133 属于粘附 G 蛋白偶联受体组。这些受体位于细胞表面，帮助它们对周围环境的信号做出反应。尽管这个受体家族仍未被完全了解，但新发现表明 GPR133 密切参与构建和维持健康骨骼的过程。 “如果这种受体因基因变化而受损，小鼠就会在幼年时表现出骨密度下降的迹象，类似于人类的骨质疏松症。使用最近通过计算机辅助屏幕识别出的 AP503 物质作为 GPR133 的刺激剂，我们能够显着提高健康小鼠和骨质疏松小鼠的骨强度，”该研究的首席研究员、医学院 Rudolf Schönheimer 生物化学研究所的 Ines Liebscher 教授解释道。 结果表明 GPR133 是未来骨质疏松症治疗的潜在有价值的靶点。研究人员发现，用 AP503 刺激受体不仅可以增加健康小鼠的骨强度，还可以增加患有骨质疏松症样骨质流失的小鼠的骨强度。 在骨组织内部，GPR133 对物理力和附近骨细胞之间的相互作用做出反应。当受体被激活时，它会发出信号，改变构建骨骼的细胞和分解骨骼的细胞之间的平衡。 成骨细胞（成骨细胞）负责产生新的骨组织。相比之下，骨吸收细胞（破骨细胞）会去除旧骨，作为骨骼正常更新周期的一部分。健康的骨骼取决于保持这两个过程之间的适当平衡。 GPR133 的激活会促进成骨细胞的活性，同时降低破骨细胞的活性。这将使骨骼变得更坚固、更耐用。 AP503 似乎模仿激活 GPR133 的自然过程。这增加了这种化合物最终可用于增加骨骼强度或帮助恢复已经削弱的骨骼的可能性。一种潜在的应用是与更年期相关的骨质疏松症，激素水平下降会加速骨质流失......

reflection.en: The discovery of how to activate bone-building processes in mice offers a glimpse into the intricate wisdom embedded within creation. Like the ancient Job, we can learn profound truths by observing the natural world, recognizing the Creator's design in the very fabric of life. This scientific pursuit reflects a deep human desire to understand and heal,...
reflection.zh: 在小鼠身上发现激活骨骼生长过程的方法，让我们得以一窥造物中蕴含的精妙智慧。正如古时的约伯，我们可以通过观察自然界获得深刻的真理，认识到生命本质中造物主的创造设计。这项科学探索反映了人类对理解和治愈的深切渴望，也呼应了造物主自身的修复之工。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Ozempic and Wegovy linked to nearly 40% fewer asthma attacks
title.zh: 奥泽平与维格威与哮喘发作减少近40%相关

summary.en: A large real-world study found that semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, was associated with a nearly 40% reduction in asthma attacks and about a 20% decrease in COPD flare-ups. Researchers suggest that GLP-1 drugs might offer respiratory benefits.
summary.zh: 一项大型真实世界研究发现，奥泽平（Ozempic）和维格威（Wegovy）中的活性成分司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）与哮喘发作减少近40%以及慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）急性加重减少约20%相关。研究人员推测，GLP-1类药物可能具有呼吸益处。

body.en:
Semaglutide, a medication widely used for type 2 diabetes and weight loss, may also provide an unexpected benefit for people with asthma. New research presented at the European Respiratory Society (ERS) Congress in Barcelona, Spain, found that semaglutide use was associated with a reduction in asthma attacks of nearly 40%.

The study was led by Professor Chloe Bloom, Clinical Associate Professor in Respiratory Epidemiology at the National Heart & Lung Institute, Imperial College London, UK, and presented by Dr. Bohee Lee.

Dr. Bloom said: "GLP-1 receptor agonists are widely used to treat type 2 diabetes and obesity. Previous research suggests that they may have anti-inflammatory effects and may improve lung-related outcomes. However, asthma and COPD outcomes have not been included as outcomes in GLP-1 drug trials.

"We wanted to use real-world health records to investigate whether people with asthma or COPD who started GLP-1 receptor agonists had fewer acute respiratory attacks."

To investigate that question, the researchers analyzed electronic medical records from the UK. They carried out four parallel studies, each involving between 20,000 and 22,000 people who had started treatment with either a GLP-1 medication or a different type of diabetes drug known as a sulfonylurea.

The results suggested that people with airway diseases such as asthma and COPD who received GLP-1 therapies experienced fewer asthma attacks and COPD flare-ups than comparable patients who were prescribed other diabetes medications.

Among the GLP-1 drugs examined, semaglutide appeared to stand out, particularly for people with asthma.

Bloom explains: "The effect was strongest with semaglutide, especially in people with asthma, where use of semaglutide appears to be associated with nearly a 40% reduction in asthma attacks. Semaglutide also led to a 20% reduction in COPD flare-ups."

The findings suggest that people who already qualify for GLP-1 receptor agonists because they have obesity or type 2 diabetes could potentially receive an additional benefit for their respiratory health.

However, Bloom emphasized that the results are not enough to recommend these medications specifically as treatments for asthma or COPD.

She explains: "The findings from this study are encouraging, but they should not change treatment decisions on their own. People with asthma or COPD should not start GLP-1 receptor agonists specifically for their lung condition outside current prescribing guidance. While the findings suggest that some people taking GLP-1 receptor agonists may experience fewer respiratory attacks, this needs confirmation in clinical trials."

Dr. Alexander Mathioudakis, Chair of the European Respiratory Society's Group on Airway Pharmacology and Treatment and Senior Lecturer in...
body.zh: 索马鲁肽是一种广泛用于治疗 2 型糖尿病和减肥的药物，也可能为哮喘患者带来意想不到的益处。在西班牙巴塞罗那举行的欧洲呼吸学会 (ERS) 大会上发表的新研究发现，使用索马鲁肽可使哮喘发作减少近 40%。 该研究由英国伦敦帝国理工学院国家心肺研究所呼吸流行病学临床副教授 Chloe Bloom 教授领导，并由 Bohee Lee 博士介绍。 Bloom博士说：“GLP-1受体激动剂广泛用于治疗2型糖尿病和肥胖症。之前的研究表明它们可能具有抗炎作用，并可能改善肺部相关的结果。然而，哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病的结果尚未被纳入GLP-1药物试验的结果中。 “我们希望利用真实世界的健康记录来调查患有哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病的患者在开始使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂后是否较少发生急性呼吸道疾病。” 为了调查这个问题，研究人员分析了来自英国的电子病历。他们进行了四项平行研究，每项研究涉及 20,000 至 22,000 名已开始使用 GLP-1 药物或另一种称为磺酰脲类的糖尿病药物进行治疗的人。 结果表明，患有哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病等气道疾病的患者接受 GLP-1 治疗后，与服用其他糖尿病药物的患者相比，哮喘发作和慢性阻塞性肺病发作的次数更少。 在检查的 GLP-1 药物中，索马鲁肽似乎脱颖而出，特别是对于哮喘患者。 Bloom 解释说：“索马鲁肽的效果最强，尤其是对于哮喘患者，使用索马鲁肽似乎可以使哮喘发作减少近 40%。索马鲁肽还使 COPD 发作减少了 20%。” 研究结果表明，因患有肥胖症或 2 型糖尿病而已经有资格使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会获得对呼吸系统健康的额外益处。 然而，布鲁姆强调，这些结果不足以推荐这些药物专门用于治疗哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病。 她解释说：“这项研究的结果令人鼓舞，但它们不应该自行改变治疗决定。哮喘或慢性阻塞性肺病患者不应在当前处方指南之外开始专门针对其肺部状况使用 GLP-1 受体激动剂。虽然研究结果表明，一些服用 GLP-1 受体激动剂的人可能会减少呼吸道疾病的发作，但这需要临床试验的证实。” Alexander Mathioudakis 博士，欧洲呼吸学会气道药理学和治疗小组主席，高级讲师...

reflection.en: It is a profound comfort when scientific inquiry uncovers unexpected avenues for healing. This research, linking GLP-1 drugs to fewer asthma attacks, echoes the ancient wisdom of bringing our concerns for the sick to God. May we continue to seek and share knowledge that alleviates suffering, trusting in divine wisdom that guides discovery.
reflection.zh: 当科学探究揭示出意想不到的疗愈途径时，这是一种深刻的安慰。这项研究将GLP-1类药物与哮喘发作减少联系起来，呼应了将病人忧虑带到雅伟面前的古老智慧。愿我们继续寻求和分享减轻痛苦的知识，信靠那引导发现的神圣智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Have we found alien life? Hundreds of scientists weigh in
title.zh: 我们找到外星生命了吗？数百名科学家发表看法

summary.en: Two major announcements in 2025 regarding potential alien life generated significant excitement. However, a survey revealed that most astrobiologists remain unconvinced, with only 6.6% believing that possible biological molecules on K2-18b likely represent extraterrestrial life, and 15.1% holding the same view for...
summary.zh: 2025年关于潜在外星生命的两项重大公告引起了巨大轰动。然而，一项调查显示，大多数天体生物学家仍持怀疑态度，只有6.6%的人认为K2-18b上可能的生物分子很可能代表外星生命，另有15.1%的人对火星上的发现持相同看法。

body.en:
It may seem like we are on the verge of discovering alien life. In 2025, a press release stated that we have the “ strongest hints yet ” of extraterrestrial life on the exoplanet K2-18b. And when talking about a collected sample from a rock named “Cheyava Falls” on Mars, NASA Administrator Sean Duffy said this was the “ closest we have ever come ” to discovering life on the red planet.

Such moments capture the imagination. But they also raise an important question: what do the majority of scientists actually think?

Surprisingly, we usually don’t know. When a scientific controversy or breakthrough dominates headlines, press officers and journalists often quote a handful of experts. These views may be insightful, but they rarely tell us what the wider scientific community thinks. And yet public discussions frequently rely on phrases such as “the science says” or “scientists believe”, as if there were a clear and measurable answer.

In reality, systematic evidence about scientific opinion is often missing. My colleagues and I recently tried to change that in the domain of astrobiology. Shortly after the two major announcements of possible extraterrestrial life in 2025, we surveyed astrobiologists to understand how expert judgment was distributed across the field.

The first case concerned the exoplanet K2-18b. In April 2025, researchers reported possible traces of molecules called dimethyl sulfide and/or dimethyl disulfide. On Earth, these are associated with biological activity. Media coverage was extensive, with many reports framing the finding as an extraordinary advance in the search for alien life.

The second case came in September, when NASA announced that Cheyava Falls appeared to preserve a potential biosignature – so-called “leopard spots” which are mineral rings that on Earth are often formed by microbial activity. Again, headlines, and NASA officials themselves, suggested something momentous.

We surveyed hundreds of astrobiologists from across the global research community, within days of each announcement. We asked a simple question: did scientists think extraterrestrial life had probably been found?

The results revealed a rather cautious picture. For K2-18b, only 6.6% of surveyed astrobiologists agreed that scientists had probably found extraterrestrial life. Nearly two-thirds disagreed, while 28.0% remained neutral. For the Mars case, confidence was higher but still cautious: 15.1% agreed, disagreement fell to 44.6% and neutrality rose to 40.3%.

Looking only at agreement and disagreement, however, misses an important part of the story. The proportion of astrobiologists who strongly disagreed fell dramatically, from 35.1% in the K2-18b case to just...
body.zh: 看起来我们正处于发现外星生命的边缘。 2025 年，一份新闻稿称，我们在系外行星 K2-18b 上获得了“迄今为止最强烈​​的迹象”，表明存在外星生命。在谈到从火星上名为“Cheyava Falls”的岩石收集的样本时，美国宇航局局长肖恩·达菲表示，这是我们“最接近”在这颗红色星球上发现生命的一次。 这样的时刻激发了人们的想象力。但他们也提出了一个重要的问题：大多数科学家实际上是怎么想的？ 令人惊讶的是，我们通常不知道。当科学争议或突破占据头条新闻时，新闻官员和记者经常引用少数专家的观点。这些观点可能很有洞察力，但它们很少告诉我们更广泛的科学界的想法。然而，公众讨论经常依赖“科学说”或“科学家相信”等短语，仿佛有一个明确且可衡量的答案。 事实上，关于科学观点的系统证据常常缺失。我和我的同事最近试图在天体生物学领域改变这一现状。在两次重大宣布 2025 年可能存在外星生命之后不久，我们对天体生物学家进行了调查，以了解专家判断在整个领域的分布情况。 第一个案例涉及系外行星 K2-18b。 2025 年 4 月，研究人员报告了可能存在被称为二甲基硫醚和/或二甲基二硫醚的分子痕迹。在地球上，这些与生物活动有关。媒体报道广泛，许多报道将这一发现视为寻找外星生命的非凡进展。 第二个案例发生在九月，当时美国宇航局宣布切亚瓦瀑布似乎保留了潜在的生物特征——所谓的“豹斑”，这是地球上通常由微生物活动形成的矿物环。头条新闻和美国宇航局官员本人再次暗示了一些重大事件。 在每次发布后的几天内，我们对来自全球研究界的数百名天体生物学家进行了调查。我们问了一个简单的问题：科学家认为可能已经发现了外星生命吗？ 结果显示出相当谨慎的情况。对于 K2-18b，只有 6.6% 的受访天体生物学家认为科学家可能已经发现了外星生命。近三分之二的人不同意，28.0% 的人保持中立。对于火星案例，信心较高，但仍持谨慎态度：同意的比例为 15.1%，不同意的比例下降至 44.6%，中立的比例上升至 40.3%。 然而，只看同意和分歧，就忽略了故事的一个重要部分。强烈反对的天体生物学家比例急剧下降，从 K2-18b 案例中的 35.1% 降至仅......

reflection.en: The pursuit of life beyond Earth is a profound human endeavor, pushing the boundaries of our knowledge. Yet, as these scientists demonstrate, true discovery requires careful observation and a humble acknowledgment of what remains unknown. The natural world, in all its complexity, is a testament to wisdom, inviting us to learn from its intricate design.
reflection.zh: 对地球以外生命的探索是一项深刻的人类事业，它不断拓展我们知识的边界。然而，正如这些科学家所展示的，真正的发现需要仔细的观察，并谦虚地承认那些仍然未知的事物。大自然以其复杂性，本身就是智慧的明证，邀请我们从其精妙的设计中学习。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Hurrah, lie-ins may be good for us – if only I can convince my five-year-old daughter | Arwa Mahdawi
title.zh: 好消息，赖床可能对我们有好处——如果我能说服我五岁的女儿的话

summary.en: The author, Arwa Mahdawi, argues for the benefits of lie-ins, contrasting this with the early-rising habits of CEOs. She cites a study presented at the European Society of Cardiology that found weekend lie-ins may protect against high blood pressure, encouraging people not to feel guilty about sleeping longer.
summary.zh: 作者 Arwa Mahdawi 提倡赖床的好处，并将其与首席执行官们早起的习惯进行对比。她引用了在欧洲心脏病学会年会上公布的一项研究，该研究发现周末赖床可能有助于预防高血压，并鼓励人们不要因为多睡一会儿而感到内疚。

body.en: CEOs may like to get up at the crack of dawn and go for a run, but I prefer optimising my life with lie-ins, trashy films, swearing and coffee This evening I’m going to tuck my five-year-old into bed and read her a chapter from one of her princess books, followed by a summary of research recently presented at the annual congress of the European Society of Cardiology. Once upon a time, I’ll tell her, there was a scientist called Dr Nawon Lee who authored a study that found having a weekend lie-in may be very good for you and can protect against high blood pressure. Our accomplished protagonist Dr Lee said: “People should not feel lazy or guilty for sleeping a little longer on the weekend.” And the moral of this story, dear child, is that you should try not to wake your mothers up at 6am every day. Unfortunately, I’m not sure that all the peer-reviewed science in the world will convince my early riser to have a weekend lie-in. Still, as a big fan of sleep and someone who has never once felt guilty for hitting the snooze button, I have to say I feel vindicated by this new study. CEOs can get up at 4am and run 10 miles before eating five foraged mushrooms if they want to, but I’m going to protect my heart health by sleeping in, any opportunity I can get, thank you very much. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 首席执行官们可能喜欢在黎明时分起床去跑步，但我更喜欢通过睡懒觉、垃圾电影、脏话和咖啡来优化我的生活。今晚，我要让我五岁的孩子上床睡觉，给她读一本公主书中的一章，然后是最近在欧洲心脏病学会年会上提出的研究摘要。我会告诉她，曾几何时，有一位名叫 Nawon Lee 博士的科学家撰写了一项研究，发现周末睡个懒觉可能对你非常有好处，并且可以预防高血压。我们的主角李博士说：“人们不应该因为周末多睡一点而感到懒惰或内疚。”亲爱的孩子，这个故事的寓意是，你应该尽量不要每天早上 6 点叫醒你的母亲。不幸的是，我不确定世界上所有经过同行评审的科学都能说服我早起的人周末睡个懒觉。尽管如此，作为睡眠的忠实粉丝和从未因按下小睡按钮而感到内疚的人，我不得不说，这项新研究证明了我的正确性。如果 CEO 愿意的话，他们可以凌晨 4 点起床，跑 10 英里，然后吃 5 个采摘的蘑菇，但我会通过睡懒觉来保护我的心脏健康，只要有机会，我都会这样做，非常感谢。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a culture that often glorifies constant activity and early rising, this news reminds us that rest is not laziness but a vital part of well-being. Just as the study suggests lie-ins can be beneficial, Jesus invites us to find true rest in Him, offering solace from the pressures of life.
reflection.zh: 在一个常常推崇持续活动和早起的文化中，这则新闻提醒我们，休息并非懒惰，而是身心健康的重要组成部分。正如研究表明赖床有益，耶稣也邀请我们在祂里面找到真正的安息，从生活的压力中获得慰藉。

verse.textEn: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
verse.textZh: 凡劳苦担重担的人，可以到我这里来，我就使你们得安息。

title.en: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS is bursting with methanol
title.zh: 星际彗星3I/ATLAS富含甲醇

summary.en: Interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS has been found to contain exceptionally high levels of methanol, suggesting it formed under conditions different from those in our solar system. Observations indicate that tiny icy grains around the comet are releasing methanol.
summary.zh: 星际彗星3I/ATLAS被发现含有异常高含量的甲醇，这表明它是在与我们太阳系中大多数彗星形成条件截然不同的环境下形成的。观测表明，彗星周围的微小冰粒正在释放甲醇。

body.en:
Comet 3I/ATLAS is continuing to surprise astronomers. New observations from the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA), of which the U.S. National Science Foundation National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NSF NRAO) is a partner, show that the interstellar visitor contains an unusually large amount of methanol. In fact, its methanol abundance exceeds that seen in almost all known comets from our own solar system.

"Observing 3I/ATLAS is like taking a fingerprint from another solar system," shares Nathan Roth, lead author on this research, and a professor with American University, "The details reveal what it's made of, and it's bursting with methanol in a way we just don't usually see in comets in our own solar system."

The research team used ALMA's Atacama Compact Array in Chile to observe 3I/ATLAS on several dates in late 2025 as it moved closer to the Sun. As sunlight heated the comet's icy surface, gas and dust escaped and created a bright cloud (or coma) around its core.

By studying the molecules in this coma, astronomers could identify the chemical makeup of material carried by the comet. Because 3I/ATLAS originated outside our solar system, those measurements provide a rare opportunity to investigate how small icy bodies may form in another planetary system without traveling beyond our own.

The scientists concentrated on the faint submillimeter signatures of two molecules: methanol (CH 3 OH), a type of alcohol, and hydrogen cyanide (HCN), a nitrogen-bearing organic molecule commonly seen in comets.

ALMA revealed that 3I/ATLAS contains an unusually high amount of methanol relative to hydrogen cyanide. On two observation dates, researchers measured methanol-to-HCN ratios of roughly 70 and 120. Those values place 3I/ATLAS among the most methanol-rich solar system comets ever studied.

The measurements suggest that the ice inside 3I/ATLAS formed under, or was later exposed to, conditions very different from those experienced by most comets in our solar system.

Earlier observations with the James Webb Space Telescope found that 3I/ATLAS had a coma dominated by carbon dioxide while it was still far from the Sun. The new ALMA measurements now add abundant methanol to the growing list of unusual features in the comet's chemical makeup.

ALMA's high resolution for imaging also allowed astronomers to track how different molecules are released and travel away from the comet. The observations revealed a striking contrast between methanol and hydrogen cyanide.

Hydrogen cyanide appears to originate mostly from the comet's central body, or nucleus. That behavior is common among comets in our solar system. Methanol, however, appears to come from both the nucleus AND from ice particles floating within the coma.

body.zh: 3I/ATLAS 彗星继续给天文学家带来惊喜。美国国家科学基金会国家射电天文台 (NSF NRAO) 的合作伙伴阿塔卡马大型毫米/亚毫米阵列 (ALMA) 的新观测结果表明，星际访客含有异常大量的甲醇。事实上，它的甲醇丰度超过了我们太阳系中几乎所有已知彗星的丰度。 “观察 3I/ATLAS 就像从另一个太阳系获取指纹，”这项研究的主要作者、美利坚大学教授内森·罗斯 (Nathan Roth) 分享道，“细节揭示了它的构成，并且它充满了甲醇，这是我们在太阳系彗星中通常不会看到的。” 研究小组使用 ALMA 位于智利的阿塔卡马紧凑阵列在 2025 年底的多个日期观测 3I/ATLAS，当时它距离太阳越来越近。当阳光加热彗星冰冷的表面时，气体和尘埃逸出，并在其核心周围形成明亮的云（或彗发）。 通过研究彗发中的分子，天文学家可以识别彗星所携带物质的化学组成。由于 3I/ATLAS 起源于我们的太阳系之外，这些测量提供了一个难得的机会来研究如何在不超出我们太阳系的情况下在另一个行星系统中形成小型冰体。 科学家们集中研究了两种分子的微弱亚毫米特征：甲醇（CH 3 OH）（一种酒精）和氰化氢（HCN）（彗星中常见的含氮有机分子）。 ALMA 揭示 3I/ATLAS 含有相对于氰化氢含量异常高的甲醇。在两个观测日，研究人员测得甲醇与 HCN 的比率约为 70 和 120。这些值使 3I/ATLAS 跻身有史以来研究过的甲醇含量最高的太阳系彗星之列。 测量结果表明，3I/ATLAS 内部的冰形成的条件或后来暴露的条件与太阳系大多数彗星所经历的条件非常不同。 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜早期的观测发现，3I/ATLAS 在距离太阳还很远的时候就有一个以二氧化碳为主的彗发。新的 ALMA 测量现在在彗星化学成分不断增加的不寻常特征中添加了丰富的甲醇。 ALMA 的高分辨率成像还使天文学家能够追踪不同分子如何释放并远离彗星。观察结果揭示了甲醇和氰化氢之间的惊人对比。 氰化氢似乎主要来自彗星的中心体或核心。这种行为在太阳系的彗星中很常见。然而，甲醇似乎来自原子核和彗发内漂浮的冰粒。 这些冰冷的小颗粒...

reflection.en: The universe is a vast library, and each celestial body, like the interstellar comet 3I/ATLAS, holds unique chapters. Studying its composition, particularly the abundance of methanol, offers a glimpse into the diverse processes of creation beyond our own solar system. This cosmic exploration reminds us that Yahweh's wisdom is revealed in the intricate...
reflection.zh: 宇宙是一座浩瀚的图书馆，而每一个天体，如星际彗星3I/ATLAS，都蕴藏着独特的篇章。研究它的构成，特别是甲醇的丰度，让我们得以一窥我们太阳系之外，那形形色色的创造过程。这场宇宙探索提醒我们，雅伟的智慧显明在他一切所造的精妙细节之中。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Devil’s Arrows: Ancient builders hauled 55,000-pound stones 11 miles for Britain’s tallest stone row
title.zh: 魔鬼之箭：古代建造者为英国最高的石阵搬运了11英里、重达55,000磅的巨石

summary.en: Britain's towering Devil's Arrows were built from 25-tonne stones hauled at least 18 kilometers from Brimham Rocks around 4,000 years ago. The discovery reveals an astonishing feat of prehistoric engineering and suggests the stones’ distant source may have been chosen for its unique properties.
summary.zh: 英国高耸的“魔鬼之箭”石阵由重达25吨（55,000磅）的巨石建成，这些巨石在大约4000年前从布林厄姆岩石区被拖运了至少18公里。这一发现揭示了史前时期惊人的工程壮举，并表明巨石遥远的来源地可能是因其独特性质而被选中的。

body.en:
Ancient builders hauled enormous 25-tonne (55,000-pound) stones across at least 18 kilometers (11 miles) to create Britain's tallest surviving prehistoric stone row, according to new research into the iconic Devil's Arrows.

The study, led by Curtin University in collaboration with the University of York, UK, is the first to pinpoint the geological source of the towering stones. Researchers traced them to Brimham Rocks, a rugged area in North Yorkshire.

Located near Boroughbridge in northern England, the Devil's Arrows rise as high as seven meters (23 feet). They form an unusual stone alignment in a lowland landscape, and despite their striking size, scientists had not been able to determine where the stones originally came from.

Researchers believe the stones were transported and raised during the Late Neolithic or Early Bronze Age, possibly around 2000 BC.

Lead author Dr. Anthony Clarke, from the Timescales of Mineral Systems Group within Curtin's School of Earth and Planetary Sciences, said the discovery challenges previous ideas about the decisions prehistoric people made when constructing major monuments.

"Our research shows these stones weren't simply taken from the nearest available source -- they were deliberately chosen from a challenging landscape 18 kilometers away," Dr. Clarke said.

"Plumpton Rocks, which is closer to the Devil's Arrows, had previously been identified as the probable source of the stones. Our findings instead point to Brimham Rocks, showing that prehistoric builders transported these enormous stones significantly further than thought.

"Each stone weighs more than 25 tonnes, so moving them would have required incredible planning, coordination and engineering skill.

"This tells us prehistoric people placed real importance on the landscape itself. It wasn't just about convenience -- the location the stones came from likely held meaning for them."

The findings suggest that the builders were not simply choosing the easiest or closest source of stone. Instead, the landscape around Brimham Rocks may have carried cultural, symbolic, or spiritual significance.

Co-author Dr. Jim Leary from the University of York said the discovery changes how researchers can interpret prehistoric monument building.

"These results show that ancient communities were making deliberate and meaningful choices about where their stones came from," Dr. Leary said.

"It highlights the importance of landscape and shared belief systems, as well as the remarkable effort involved in transporting and raising stones of this size."

To determine where the stones came from, the researchers used a new low-impact sampling technique. Adhesive tape allowed them to collect tiny mineral grains from the stones without damaging the monument.

They then analyzed...
